chapters: Jano' ba' na ja'p gu gɨ'kora' gu Dabii ka't guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn kia'mi'ñ gu tanoolh guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat jajannulhi'ñ gu' cham guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ.

Jano' ba' gui'p guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam tu duukam; gio ba' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu Jawatan gu gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ na ba' vupui bhaan gu gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu Jawatan gu gɨ'kora'.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm bɨx gu oidha' gu Israeel gu ñi'ook gu Abisag gu Sunamita aichdhak gu gɨ'kora'.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ ka't guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ; gu' gu gɨ'kora' cham pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Adoniia gu mar gu aggit jix búup bham; gio ba' tu' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios; mi' dhɨr jix duu guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu ja'tkam kavaayo mambhɨɨx gu chichio'ñ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn vupui bhaan.

Jano' ba' gu taat cham pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam bɨx gu tanoolh bɨɨx jix aa'; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gio guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam ka't tu jiim guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ; mi' dhɨr dua'ñ guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ mi' dhɨr gu Absalom.
Jano' ba' ga'ra' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios bɨɨx gu Joab gu mar gu Sarbia bɨɨx gu Abiatar jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu Adoniia.
Gu' gu' gu Sadok jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu Benaiia gu mar gu Joiada gu Nataan jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu Semei gu Reii bɨx gu Dabii cham oi'ñchu' gu Adoniia.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu Adoniia kakneer guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu vaakax guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam ju'ñdharan jodai kavɨk gu Soelet mia'n suudai' buusñi gu Rogel guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat bɨx gu ja'tkam gu ma'nkam gu gɨ'kora' bɨx gu chio'ñ gu Judaa tu duukam gu gɨ'kora'.
Gu' gu' cham guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu Nataan jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan tu' gu Benaiia tu' gu Salomoon xibhɨk.
Ba' jix aa' gu Nataan gu Bat-seba gu naan gu Salomoon bham; gio ba' cham naak guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu Adoniia gu mar gu aggit cham maachim gu Dabii chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ jano' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ na ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu oidha' gu mar gu Salomoon.

Jano' ba' tu' ba'k gu gɨ'kora' gu Dabii guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn; gio ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam cham tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn ja'tkam na tu juan bham; mi' dhɨr gu Salomoon gu mar guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa mi' dhɨr tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ atooxkor guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu Adoniia.
Jano' ba' kua' tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn a'gi'ñchu' bɨɨx gu gɨ'kora' tu' ba'k bhaan tu' gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Bat-seba chɨbiapui gu gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam; gio ba' gu gɨ'kora' ka't guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn; mi' dhɨr gu Abisag gu Sunamita guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu Bat-seba guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios tu' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' gu gɨ'kora' jix aa'; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa.

Jano' ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu Jawatan guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam tu' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ ja'tkam na tu juan guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Jawatan Dios bham; mi' dhɨr gu Salomoon gu mar guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa mi' dhɨr tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ atooxkor.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm jano' gu Adoniia guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim; gio ba' tu' gu Jawatan gu gɨ'kora' jano' cham guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios.

Jano' ba' tu' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu vaakax guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam mumua'da' kakneer tu' amuub bɨx gu ma'nkam gu gɨ'kora' gu Abiatar jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu Joab guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham; gu' gu Salomoon tu duukam cham tu' amuub.

Jano' ba' tɨjɨɨ'ñ guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu vupui bɨx gu Israeel bhaan tu' na ba' jix duu chɨkka tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ atooxkor gu Jawatan gu gɨ'kora' mi' dhɨr.

Na pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios na pai' dhuuk gu Jawatan gu gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ bɨɨx tattat tu' gu mar gu Salomoon duduaka' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ.
Jano' ba' kua' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn a'gi'ñchu' bɨɨx gu gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Nataan jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan suudai' u'va.

Jano' ba' jix maa aa'ñdham gu gɨ'kora' bham; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Nataan jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan; mi' dhɨr na ja'p chɨbiapui gu gɨ'kora' o'lhia'n vupui bhaan gu gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios gu vupui gu oidha'.
Ba' jix aa' gu Nataan; gio ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam tu' tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu Adoniia guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa mi' dhɨr tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ atooxkor.

Na gu' na gu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ tu' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa tu' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu vaakax guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam mumua'da' kakneer tu' amuub bɨx gu ma'nkam gu gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gio gu Abiatar jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios vupui bhaan guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu gɨ'kora' gu Adoniia.
Gu' gu' tu' tu duukam tu' gu Sadok jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan tu' gu Benaiia gu mar gu Joiada tu' gu Salomoon tu duukam tu' amuub.

Jano' ba' dhi' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Jawatan gu gɨ'kora' cham guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn tu duukam chɨkka ka't guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ atooxkor gu Jawatan gu gɨ'kora' mi' dhɨr.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Dabii; gio ba' mɨmɨim gu Bat-seba; mi' dhɨr chɨbiapui guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu gɨ'kora' jix dhaas vupui bhaan gu gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios bham; gio ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu Jawatan Dios tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu i'ii'ñ bɨx guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ.

Na na ja'p tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel bham; gio ba' gu mar gu Salomoon guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa mi' dhɨr tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ atooxkor pai' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam; na guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Bat-seba guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios gu gɨ'kora' gu vupui gu oidha' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu Jawatan gu gɨ'kora' gu Dabii na ba' bɨɨx tas.

Ba' jix aa' gu gɨ'kora' gu Dabii; gio ba' mɨmɨim gu Sadok jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu Nataan jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu Benaiia gu mar gu Joiada; mi' dhɨr baap guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu gɨ'kora'.

Ba' jix aa' gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn bɨɨx guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat tu duukam gu Jawatan guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu Salomoon gu mar guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu Gioon.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu Sadok jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu Nataan jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu gɨ'kora' bhaan gu Israeel; gio ba' kuichdha' kuu'ñdham na jix kavɨk bham; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu gɨ'kora' gu Salomoon.

Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ ɨlhdham guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ atooxkor guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu'; na gu' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim na ba' ka't gɨ'kora' ja'tkam bhaan gu Israeel bhaan gu Judaa.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Benaiia gu mar gu Joiada gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' gu Ameen; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu Jawatan Dios gu Jawatan gu gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios tu' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ bɨɨx gu Jawatan gu gɨ'kora' ka't bɨɨx gu Salomoon; gio ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn jix gɨ' atooxkor gu Jawatan gu gɨ'kora' gu Dabii.

Jano' ba' jix dhaav gu Sadok jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu Nataan jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu Benaiia gu mar gu Joiada gu Kereteos gu Peleteos tu' jix duu guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu Salomoon guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu gɨ'kora' gu Dabii bhɨɨk gu Gioon.

Jano' ba' dhaagɨk gu Sadok jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga bɨ'ñdhatu' vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu Salomoon; gio ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam kuu'ñdham na jix kavɨk jix aa' bɨx gu ja'tkam; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu gɨ'kora' gu Salomoon.

Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr jix tɨ'ɨ bɨx gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu ja'tkam bɨɨx guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu oidha' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ bɨɨx tu ñi'ook.

Na pai' dhuuk jix kai gu Adoniia bɨx koi'cham bɨɨx mi'p na pai' dhuuk tu' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu ñi'ook jugi; gio ba' tɨiñ gu Joab guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam kuu'ñdham na jix kavɨk jix aa'; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ kiicham bɨɨx guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn.

Ba' jix aa' kua' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn a'gi'ñchu' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Jonataan gu mar gu Abiatar jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan suudai' u'va gu Adoniia; na gu' ba'k na gu' tu' jix duu gu chio'ñ guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jonataan gu Adoniia; gio ba' gu ñi'ook chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan gu gɨ'kora' gu Dabii tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu gɨ'kora' gu Salomoon.

Jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' tu' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ bɨɨx gu Sadok jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu Nataan jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu Benaiia gu mar gu Joiada gio gu Kereteos gu Peleteos jix duu guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu gɨ'kora'.

Jano' ba' gu Sadok jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu Nataan jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ Xoi'kam gu Gioon guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ tu jiim bɨɨx guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn kiicham guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn; mi' dhɨr dhi' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ naak.
Jano' ba' gio gu Salomoon tu' daakat atooxkor oi'dha' na gɨ'kora'.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ tu duukam gu gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ tɨbiap guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan gu gɨ'kora' gu Dabii bham; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn jix bhai' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Salomoon guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu tɨɨgɨ' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn jix gɨ' atooxkor guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ; mi' dhɨr gu gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa.

Ba' jix aa' gio gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ ka't gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel tu' jix maa guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ atooxkor guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu vupui.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam jix búup bɨx koi'cham mi'p bɨɨx gu Adoniia ka't maa'n guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu bhóogɨt.
Gu' gu' gu Adoniia guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu Salomoon jix búup ka't guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ jodai maa'nkar Jawatan.

Jano' ba' ka't guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam maachim gu Salomoon bham; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Adoniia juraa'n ɨɨbhi'ñ gu gɨ'kora' gu Salomoon; na gu' tu' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ jodai maa'nkar Jawatan bham; jano' ba' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu gɨ'kora' gu Salomoon cham guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam tu duukam.
Ba' jix aa' gu Salomoon; gio ba' tu' ua'tulhi'ñ guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn tu' maa'n kuupa'n guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu oidha'; gu' tu' bakia' cham bhai' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam.

Jano' ba' bhañ gu gɨ'kora' gu Salomoon aichdhak jodai maa'nkar Jawatan; gio ba' suudai' u'va tu' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios gu gɨ'kora' gu Salomoon; mi' dhɨr gu Salomoon jix aa'; jano' ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu vaak.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu tanoolh gu Dabii na ba' koi jix aa'ñdhix gu Salomoon gu mar bham.
Jano' ba' tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu bhóogɨt bɨx gu oidha'; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ tu' gu chio'ñ.

Jano' ba' jix nukadham jir bɨx bhai' gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu bhóogɨt guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat ñi'ook kavɨk gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga ua'nak ñi'ook na tu a'ga gu Moisees na ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam tu ñi'ook bɨx tu jiim bɨx mii' dhɨr tu' tu jiim.

Ba' jix aa' na ba' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook bham; gio ba' tu' gu ma'nkam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu bhóogɨt guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ vupui bhaan tu' bɨɨx tu'r bɨx gu i'ii'ñ bɨx gu i'ii'ñ mɨɨjidha' tu ñi'ook guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ tu' gu chio'ñ atooxkor gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' jix duu tu' ñɨidhat tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu Joab gu mar gu Sarbia gook guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu Israeel gu Abner gu mar gu Ner gu Amasa gu mar gu Jeter guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios bhai'x i'ii'ñ gu ɨ'ɨr bhɨɨ'ñdham guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu ɨ'ɨr bhɨɨ'ñdham guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga ga'ra' bhaan guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam ga'ra' tɨɨt.
Jano' ba' tu' jix duu jurtu'nka' matda'; gio ba' cham kiicha' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ bhai'x i'ii'ñ.

Gu' gu' gu ma'nkam gu Barsillai gu Galaadita jix duu xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch ka't koi'cham meesa; na pai' dhuuk na gu' tɨɨtɨs tu' na pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu Absalom xibhɨk.

Ba' jix aa' gio guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa bɨndak gu Semei gu mar gu Gera gu mar gu Benjamiin gu Baurim guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam bɨɨx mu'ai jix kavɨk gu tanoolh tu' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu Maanaim; gu' jix dhaav guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu Jordaan tu' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Jawatan Dios bham; mi' dhɨr tu' cham tu' kooda' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam.

Gu' cham guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn jano' cham guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ; na gu chio'ñ jix maat jix duu ñɨidhat gu ñi'ook tu' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat bɨɨx; mi' dhɨr jix duu guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam bɨɨx gu ɨ'ɨr guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn.
Jano' ba' gu Dabii jix koox bɨɨx tattat ka't guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ kiicham gu Dabii.

Jano' ba' gu tanoolh jix gɨ'kora' gu Dabii bhaan gu Israeel jix bɨɨx duu oo'm guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ; gio ba' kɨɨv guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ jix gɨ'kora' gu ebroon guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ vaik guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ jix gɨ'kora' gu Jerusalem.
Jano' ba' jix daa gu Salomoon atooxkor gu Dabii gu taat ka't oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Adoniia gu mar gu aggit suudai' u'va gu Bat-seba gu naan gu Salomoon; gio ba' jix aa'; mi' dhɨr namkia' bhai'x i'ii'ñ jix aa'; jano' ba' bhai'x i'ii'ñ.
Ba' jix aa' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam; gio ba' gu ñi'ook no'ñ guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ; mi' dhɨr jix aa'; jano' ba' tu'.

Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' tu' ñɨidhat oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' ka't guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam bɨx gu Israeel ka't guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam tu' gu vupui na ba' tu' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ; gu' oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' ka't bhaan suudai' u'va xibhɨk; na gu' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Jawatan Dios ka't guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam.
Jano' ba' jano' tu' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ; gio ba' cham guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu vupui; mi' dhɨr jix aa'; jano' ba' tu ñi'ook.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba'; na gu' tu' soi'ñ tu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' gu Salomoon na gu' cham tu' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu vupui na ba' jix maa gu Abisag gu Sunamita guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu u'vɨ.
Ba' jix aa' gu Bat-seba; gio ba' xoi'kam; mi' dhɨr tu' tu ñi'ook guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu' gu gɨ'kora'.

Jano' ba' suudai' u'va gu Bat-seba gu gɨ'kora' gu Salomoon na ba' ñiokda' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Adoniia; gio ba' gu gɨ'kora' jix búup jix duu tu' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ atooxkor tu' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu naan gu gɨ'kora' jix daa kɨɨ'n.

Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios tu'; mi' dhɨr cham guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu vupui; jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' jix aa'; gio ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu naan guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ tu' cham tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu vupui.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu Abisag gu Sunamita guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu u'vɨ xibhɨk gu Adoniia.

Ba' jix aa' gu gɨ'kora' gu Salomoon gu naan; na gu' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu Abisag gu Sunamita na ba' gu Adoniia gu Demanda gio na ba' oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' na gu' xibhɨk jix gɨ'; mi' dhɨr juraa'n gio gu Abiatar jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu Joab gu mar gu Sarbia.

Jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Salomoon guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Jawatan Dios bham; gio ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat bhaan gu oidha' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Adoniia dhi' gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' jano' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu Jawatan Dios tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam bhaan atooxkor gu Dabii gu taat tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu vaak na ja'p ka't tu ñi'ook gu Adoniia guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Salomoon bhañ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu novɨ gu Benaiia gu mar gu Joiada jix maa bhaan jix koi.

Ba' jix aa' gu Abiatar jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu Anatot dɨppɨr tu' jix duu suuska'n koi'm; na gu' gu' cham tu' kooda' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ na gu' baabuk kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios vupui bhaan gu Dabii gu taat guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ tu'x ka't guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu taat.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu Salomoon gu Abiatar jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios na ba' kuugalh gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios ka't tu ñi'ook bhaan gu vaak gu Eli gu Silo.

Jano' ba' suudai' u'va guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios bɨɨx ka'm gu Joab; na gu' gio gu Joab ka't guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu Adoniia tu' xoi'kam cham ka't guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu Absalom; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu Joab vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ jodai maa'nkar Jawatan.

Jano' ba' ka't guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam maachim gu Salomoon gu Joab ka't guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios ka't ju'ñdharan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan; gio ba' jano' ba' bhañ gu Salomoon gu Benaiia gu mar gu Joiada bham; mi' dhɨr gu Be jix maa bhaan.

Ba' jix aa' chɨbiapui gu Benaiia vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu gɨ'kora' tu' tu ñi'ook guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm; mi' dhɨr jix aa'; jano' ba' cham guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat koi; gio ba' gu Benaiia guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ bɨɨx dhi' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu gɨ'kora' bham; mi' dhɨr tu ñi'ook gu Joab jix aa'.

Ba' jix aa' gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' gu vupui na ja'p tu' tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ tu' gu vaak gu taat gu ɨ'ɨr gu Joab tu' vaak na jix bhaan guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ.

Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu ɨ'ɨr bhaan mo'o; na tu' jix koi gook gu chio'ñ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ jir bhai' ja'tkam tutkɨ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam cham gu taat gu Dabii guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ cham tu'; mi' dhɨr gu Abner gu mar gu Ner guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu Israeel gu Amasa gu mar gu Jeter guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu Judaa.

Jano' ba' gu ɨ'ɨr guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ bhaan mo'o gu Joab bhaan mo'o gu kai' na ba' bɨɨx tas; gu' bhaan gu Dabii bhaan gu kai' bhaan gu vaak bhaan atooxkor guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ bhai'x i'ii'ñ baasɨ'n gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Benaiia gu mar gu Joiada jix tɨ'ɨ jix maa bhaan guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ; gio ba' ka't guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu vaak oidha' jix gaki.
Jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' jix dhaas pai' gu Benaiia gu mar gu Joiada bhaan ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham; gio ba' gu Sadok jix dhaas gu gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan pai' gu Abiatar.

Ba' jix aa' mi' dhɨr bhañ gu gɨ'kora' tu' jix duu guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu Semei; gio ba' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu vaak gu Jerusalem guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios cham guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm baasɨ'n tu'.
Na gu' na gu' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tɨɨda' gu tanoolh tu jiim jix jiim bhi'ñbak gu Kedroon cham guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga koi gu ɨ'ɨr ka't bhaan mo'o.

Ba' jix aa' gu Semei gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook jix bhai'; mi' dhɨr na ja'p gu gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan tu' tu ñi'ook guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam tu duukam; jano' ba' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu Semei gu Jerusalem mui'x gu tanoolh.

Gu' gu' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn vaik guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ ka't jiboi'ññor gu Semei gook tu duukam gu Akîs gu mar gu Maakâ gu gɨ'kora' gu Gat; gio ba' jix maa aa'ñdham gu Semei bham; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu duukam gu Gat.

Jano' ba' jix búup jano' ba' gu Semei guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim buur ka't gu Gat gu Akîs guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn tu duukam; gio ba' ka't gu Semei guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ tu duukam gu Gat.
Ba' jix aa' gu Salomoon na ja'p gu Semei ka't guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu Jerusalem bɨɨx ka'm gu Gat ka't guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' bhañ tu' jix duu guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu Semei; gio ba' cham tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn tu' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Jawatan Dios tu' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim bham; mi' dhɨr gu tanoolh tu jiim guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tɨɨda' koi tu' tu ñi'ook; jano' ba' gu ñi'ook jix bhai' tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim cham guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn.

Ba' jix aa' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu gɨ'kora' gu Semei; gio ba' tu' ñɨidhat bɨx cham bhai' gu i'ii'ñ xoi'kam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios bhaan gu taat gu Dabii; mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan Dios tu' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios cham bhai' bhaan mo'o.
Jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Salomoon ka't guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ atooxkor gu Dabii ka't gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' jix aa'ñdhix gu Benaiia gu mar gu Joiada jix buus tu' naaka'n; gio ba' jix koi; mi' dhɨr oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' ka't guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu novɨ gu Salomoon.

Jano' ba' jix duu gu Salomoon guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ bɨɨx gu Faraoon gu gɨ'kora' gu Ejipto na gu' jix bhɨɨ mar u'vɨ gu Faraoon guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam kiicham gu Dabii tɨjɨɨ'ñ guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios vaak jodai gu Jerusalem xikoolh.

Jano' ba' bɨɨx ka'm jano' ba' gu ja'tkam maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios; na gu' cham ka't gu vaak guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx ka'm mii' dhɨr ja'tkam guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn.

Gu' gu' gu Salomoon guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ ñi'ook kavɨk gu taat gu Dabii; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios.

Na gu' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu gɨ'kora' gu Gabaoon na gu' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ ka't guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gɨ'kora' ja'tkam maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan; gio ba' mambhɨɨx gɨ' maa'nkar tai bhaan maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan gu Salomoon bhaan mii' dhɨr jodai maa'nkar Jawatan.
Jano' ba' jix ñi'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu Salomoon gu Gabaoon gu tukaa' tɨɨtki' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim tu jiim tu' jix maa.

Ba' jix aa' gu Salomoon; gio ba' tu' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch tu duukam gu Dabii gu taat bhaan jix jiim vupui bhaan tu' tu'r bɨx bhai' bɨɨx guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu i'ii'ñ na ba' bɨndak; mi' dhɨr tu' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat dhi' jix gɨ' xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch chɨɨdak gu mar guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim atooxkor na ja'p guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios dhi' gu tanoolh.

Jano' ba' jano' gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam tu' tu duukam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu gɨ'kora' pai' gu Dabii gu taat; gio ba' tu' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ jix ali' cham tu' gu ñi'ook baakɨi tu' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam.

Jano' ba' tu duukam tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ja'tkam tu' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga; gio ba' gu ja'tkam jix gɨ' cham jɨ'xdha' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam tu' jix duu guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam.

Jano' ba' jix maa tu duukam gu i'ii'ñ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ na ba' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu ja'tkam na ba' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix bhai' cham bhai'; na gu' chɨkka guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios dhi' gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios jix gɨ'.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ vupui bhaan gu Adonai gu Salomoon guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ dhi'.

Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' tu ñi'ook dhi' cham guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa na ba' tu' mui'x gu tanoolh tu' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa na ba' tu' namkɨm tu' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu oidha' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ na ba' tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn na ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ ñi'ook na jir bhai'.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam jurtu'nka' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu' jix maa gu i'ii'ñ jix maat guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam cham ka't guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat va'k tu' na ja'p tu' mi' dhɨr tu' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam na ja'p tu'.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gio tu' jix maa tu'x cham guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa namkɨm gɇ'kamtu'nda'; gio ba' tu jiim tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ ka't na ja'p tu' bɨx gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' tu' tu jiim gu bhóogɨt guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm ñi'ook kavɨk gu ñi'ook na ja'p jix jiim gu Dabii gu taat tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu tanoolh.

Jano' ba' na ja'p gu Salomoon guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios jix ñi' ka't guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam; gio ba' suudai' u'va gu Jerusalem guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm vupui bhaan kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' ñi'ook na jix bhaan gu Jawatan Dios maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan maa'nkar tai bhaan tu' jix duu guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam; mi' dhɨr jix duu gio guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ bɨx tu duukam.
Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam tɨɨtɨs gook gu u'vɨ jix duu gu gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm vupui bhaan.
Ba' jix aa' gu u'vɨ; gio ba' tu' gu Jawatan guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam tu' dhi' gu u'vɨ guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu vaak tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn kua' bɨɨx gu vaak.

Jano' ba' ka't vaik gu tanoolh mi' dhɨr tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gio guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ mai' ka't gu vaak guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gook gu vaak.
Na gu' gu tukaa' gu mar dhi' gu u'vɨ jix koi na gu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ bhaan.
Jano' ba' jix búup ɨraab gu tukaa' jix bhɨɨ gu mar ju'ñdharan tu' kua' tu' ja'tkam na tu juan kookos jix dhaas guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim jix dhaas guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu mar jix koi.

Jano' ba' na ja'p tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu xibh na ba' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ baaso gu mar guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm ka't jix koi; gu' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu xibh tu' cham ka't gu mar tu' ka't guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu u'vɨ; gio ba' cham; mi' dhɨr gu mar guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu mar jix koi; jano' ba' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam; gio ba' cham; mi' dhɨr gu mar jix koi gu mar guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam; jano' ba' tu ñi'ook vupui bhaan gu gɨ'kora'.

Ba' jix aa' gu gɨ'kora' jano' ba'; gio ba' dhi' tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu mar guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu mar jix koi; jano' ba' tu ñi'ook cham gu' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ jix koi gu mar guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam.
Ba' jix aa' gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam; mi' dhɨr aichdhak gu gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam.

Ba' jix aa' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tɨjɨɨ'ñ guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat tɨjɨɨ'ñ.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu u'vɨ ka't gu mar guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu gɨ'kora' na gu' ba'k guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu mar; gio ba' tu' gu Jawatan guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga cham guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim; gu' jix aa'; jano' ba' tu'; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu mar guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga cham guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim; mi' dhɨr gu naan.

Jano' ba' bɨx gu Israeel jix kai mii' dhɨr ñi'ook na jir bhai' ka't jix maa gu gɨ'kora'; na gu' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu gɨ'kora' na gu' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn ka't matda' gu Jawatan Dios na ba' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa.
Jano' ba' ka't gu gɨ'kora' gu Salomoon gu gɨ'kora' bhaan bɨx gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam jix bɨɨx duu chiñia' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim; gio ba' gu Asariias gu mar gu Sadok jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan.
Jano' ba' gu Eliorep gu Aiia gu ma'nkam gu Sisa guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam; gio ba' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu mar gu Ailud guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam.
Jano' ba' gu Benaiia gu mar gu Joiada ka't bhaan ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham; gio ba' gu Sadok gu Abiatar guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan.

Jano' ba' gu Asariia gu mar gu Nataan ka't bhaan guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ; gio ba' gu Sabud gu mar gu Nataan ka't gɨ'kora' ja'tkam guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' gu Aisar ka't guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn; gio ba' gu Adoniram gu mar gu Abda ka't bhaan namki'ñdha'.

Jano' ba' ga'ra' gu Salomoon guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ bhaan bɨx gu Israeel guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu gɨ'kora' gu vaak; gio ba' maa'n ka't guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ oidha' tas.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ; gio ba' gu mar gu ur gu kavɨk gu Epraim.
Jano' ba' gu mar gu Dekar gu Makkas gu Saalbim gu Bet-semes gu Eloon gu Bet-anan.
Jano' ba' gu mar gu esed gu Arubot; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam ga'ra' gio gu Sokô bɨx gu oidha' gu Epet.
Jano' ba' gu mar gu Abinadab bɨx guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu Dor; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam ga'ra' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu u'vɨ gu Tapat mar u'vɨ gu Salomoon.

Jano' ba' gu Baana gu mar gu Ailud gu Taanak gu Megiddo bɨx gu Bet-san mia'n gu Saretaan guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu Jesreel dɨr gu Bet-san bɨɨx ka'm gu Abel-meola bɨɨx ka'm baasɨ'n gu Jokmeam.

Jano' ba' gu mar gu Geber gu Ramot gu Galaad; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam ga'ra' gio jɨ'dɨlh gu Jair gu mar gu Manasees mi'p gu Galaad; mi' dhɨr ga'ra' gio oidha' gɨ' gu Argob ka't gu Basaan guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ jɨ'dɨlh bɨɨx vaak jodai guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam jix vɨgɨ jodai.
Jano' ba' gu Ainadab gu mar gu Iddo gu Maanaim.
Jano' ba' gu Aimaas gu Neptalii; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam jix bhɨɨ gio guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu u'vɨ gu Basemat mar u'vɨ gu Salomoon.
Jano' ba' gu Baana gu mar gu usai gu Aser gu Alot.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu mar gu Parua gu Issakâr.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu mar gu Ela gu Benjamiin.

Jano' ba' gu Geber gu mar gu Uri gu oidha' gu Galaad gu oidha' gu Seoon gu gɨ'kora' gu Amorreos gu Og gu gɨ'kora' gu Basaan; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam ka't guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ mii' dhɨr pai'.

Jano' ba' gu Judaa tu' gu Israeel guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm mui'x na ja'p oo' ju'ñdharan gu gɨ' suudai' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga.

Jano' ba' gu Salomoon aapi' bhaan bɨx guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa dɨr gɨ' suudai' jiim gu oidha' gu Pilisteos bɨɨx ka'm gu oidha' gu Ejipto; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu Salomoon bɨx gu tanoolh jix pai'.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu Salomoon ka't gu tanoolh guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ.

Jano' ba' mambhɨɨx gu vaakax guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu vaakax guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim kakneer; gio ba' cham guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ chiiw guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu u'uvhig guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam.

Na gu' na gu' aapi' bɨx guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ ka't baasɨ'n gɨ' suudai' jiim dɨr gu Tipsa bɨɨx ka'm gu Gasa bhaan bɨx gu gɨ'kora' baasɨ'n gɨ' suudai' jiim; gio ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim bhai'x i'ii'ñ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm bɨx guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam.

Jano' ba' gu Judaa tu' gu Israeel guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim maa'n bɨtaa'n guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ bɨtaa'n iigɨx dɨr gu Dan bɨɨx ka'm gu Beer-seba bɨx gu tanoolh gu Salomoon.

Jano' ba' ga'ra' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn dhi' gu Salomoon oo'm mambhɨɨx gɨ' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm kavaayo na ba' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm mambhɨɨx gɨ' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn.

Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu gɨ'kora' gu Salomoon bɨx meesa gu gɨ'kora' gu Salomoon aajidha' maa'n guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam cham tu' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gio guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ kai' vaas guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ na ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm na ba' gu vaakax gu ñi'ook pai' ka't maa'n jurtu'nka' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ ga'ra'.
Jano' ba' jix maa gu Jawatan Dios gu Salomoon matda' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam jix gɨ' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu i'ii'ñ na ja'p oo' jugii'ñ gu gɨ' suudai'.
Na ka't jix gɨ' matda' gu Salomoon bɨx guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ bɨx matda' gu Egipkios.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ ka't guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ jix maat bɨx gu chichio'ñ; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu Etaan gu Esraita gu Emaan gu Kalkôl gu Darda gu ma'nkam gu Maol; mi' dhɨr ka't guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam tɨjɨɨ'ñ guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu ja'tkam xikoolh.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn vaik mambhɨɨx gɨ' ua'rgidhat; gio ba' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa jix bɨɨx duu mambhɨɨx gɨ' jixchamaam.

Jano' ba' gio guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu u'u dɨr gɨ' u'u kavɨk gu Liibano bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu vaakax gu u'uvhig gu ko'oi gu vatop.
Jano' ba' aajidha' bɨx gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ matda' gu Salomoon bɨx gu gɨ'kora' gu oidha' pai' ka't tu jiim guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm matda'.

Jano' ba' gu iram gu gɨ'kora' gu Tiro bhañ gio tu duukam gu Salomoon jix kai guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat Xoi'kam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu gɨ'kora' pai' gu taat; na gu' gu iram ka't bɨɨx tas dha' gu Dabii.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Salomoon bhañ guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu iram.

Jano' ba' tu' ñɨidhat na ja'p gu taat gu Dabii cham guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu vaak gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ bɨɨx ka'm gu Jawatan Dios jix dhaas guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu vaas tɨɨt.

Jano' ba' jano' gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix maa jɨɨpi'ñka' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios; na tu' cham tu'x jai'ch guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu' cham bhai' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa.

Ba' jix aa' tu' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam jano' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu vaak gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jawatan Dios na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios gu Dabii gu taat bham; gio ba' gu mar tu' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios pai' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ atooxkor guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu vaak gu tɨɨgɨ'.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim jano' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu Liibano; gio ba' tu duukam no'm bɨɨx guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu duukam guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ tu' tu ñi'ook; na gu' tu' ñɨidhat xoi'kam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ cham tu'x jai'ch tɨjɨɨ'ñ no'ch guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu u'u na ja'p gu Sidonios.

Ba' jix aa' na ja'p gu iram jix kai gu ñi'ook gu Salomoon guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn; gio ba' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ ka't guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu Jawatan Dios jix maa gu mar jix maat gu Dabii bhaan dhi' gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios jix gɨ'.

Jano' ba' bhañ gu iram guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu Salomoon; gio ba' naak guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam; mi' dhɨr tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ bɨx tu' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu u'u gɨ' u'u kavɨk gu u'u ka't.

Jano' ba' tu duukam guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ dɨr gu Liibano gu gɨ' suudai'; gio ba' tu' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu gɨ' suudai' bɨɨx ka'm pai' tu' nɨi'ñchudat guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios tu' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn; mi' dhɨr tu' jix duu aagak guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ jugi ja'tkam vaak.
Jano' ba' jix maa gu iram gu Salomoon gu u'u gɨ' u'u kavɨk gu u'u ka't bɨx guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ.

Jano' ba' gu Salomoon guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu iram guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ mambhɨɨx gɨ' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam tiriik na ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim ja'tkam vaak guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam bɨ'ñdhatu' na jix bhai'; gio ba' dhi' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu Salomoon gu iram oidha' tas.
Jano' ba' jix maa gu Jawatan Dios gu Salomoon matda' na ja'p ka't tu ñi'ook; gio ba' ka't bhai'x i'ii'ñ tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu iram gu Salomoon tu' jix duu ñi'ook na jix bhaan tɨjɨɨ'ñ guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ.
Jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Salomoon guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios namki'ñdha' bɨx gu Israeel namki'ñdha' ka't guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ mambhɨɨx gɨ' gu chichio'ñ.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu Liibano mambhɨɨx mambhɨɨx gɨ' mambhɨɨx mambhɨɨx gɨ' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn bai'ñpu' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu Liibano gook masaa'n gu vaak; gio ba' gu Adoniram ka't bhaan mii' dhɨr namki'ñdha'.

Jano' ba' ga'ra' gio gu Salomoon guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm mambhɨɨx gɨ' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam mambhɨɨx gɨ' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu kavɨk.
Jano' ba' cham gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu Salomoon mi'p bhaan tu duukam vaik mambhɨɨx gɨ' vaik ko'kmarak guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam tu duukam.
Jano' ba' jix aa'ñdhix gu gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu jodai u'uuk na ba' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios gu vaak gu jodai guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Salomoon gu iram guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu u'u tɨ'ya' na ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu vaak.

Jano' ba' ka't oidha' tas guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam mi' dhɨr gu ma'nkam gu Israeel moor gu Ejipto maakobh oidha' tas gɨ'kora' ja'tkam oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu Salomoon bhaan gu Israeel guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu Sip guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gook kua'da' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' jix duu gu vaak gu gɨ'kora' gu Salomoon gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ tu jiim guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim vupui bhaan vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan gu vaak guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ tu jiim bhaan guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu vaak guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga ka't mambhɨɨx guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ vupui bhaan gu vaak.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu vaak guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu jiim guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm mai'.

Jano' ba' jix duu gio ju'ñdharan vaak jodai gu vaak guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa xikoolh bhaan guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu vaak guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios; gio ba' tu' jix duu xikoolh.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga ka't jixchamaam guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga tɨjɨɨ'ñ guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga vaik kɨɨv guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga; na gu' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm mai' ka't guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu vaak guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ na ba' cham guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu vaak.

Jano' ba' jix duu gu vaak na pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu jodai guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ tu' gu ñi'ook; na pai' dhuuk tu jiim na pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ tu' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu vaak tu' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ jix kavɨk jodai.

Jano' ba' ki'ñgob guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios tɨjɨɨ'ñ ka't guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim jix duu gu vaak; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ tɨjɨɨ'ñ guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios tɨjɨɨ'ñ vaik.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu vaak jix bɨɨx duu; gio ba' jix bhaan dhaas gu vaak bɨɨx guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gɨ' u'u kavɨk.

Jano' ba' jix duu guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ bɨx gu vaak tu jiim jixchamaam guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu vaak bɨɨx gɨ' u'u kavɨk.
Jano' ba' ka't gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Salomoon bham.

Jano' ba' dhi' gu vaak tu' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ tu' tu jiim ñi'ook kavɨk tu' tu jiim guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ nukadham bɨx gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ tu' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu ñi'ook bɨndak gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook gu Dabii gu taat.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel cham guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu ja'tkam gu Israeel.
Na ba' gu Salomoon guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu vaak jix bɨɨx duu.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu vaak guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu jiim bɨɨx guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios gɨ' u'u kavɨk guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu u'u guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu jiim dɨr guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu vaak bɨɨx ka'm guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios; gio ba' jix bhaan dhaas gio guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn bɨɨx gu u'u ka't.

Jano' ba' jix duu guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu vaak guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios gɨ' u'u kavɨk dɨr guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam bɨɨx ka'm guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ; gio ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu vaak guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios pai' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam.
Jano' ba' gu vaak maachim vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan tu jiim ga'ra' oo'm guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ.

Jano' ba' gu vaak ka't iiñat gɨ' u'u kavɨk guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu jiim ga'ra' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa; gio ba' bɨx ka't gɨ' u'u kavɨk; mi' dhɨr matgɨm gu jodai guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu jiim tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu vaak na ba' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' ñi'ook na jix bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios ka't baasɨ'n guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ ga'ra' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ tu jiim guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ tu jiim; gio ba' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn jix uam jodai guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam jix bhaan dhaas jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gɨ' u'u kavɨk.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu Salomoon jix uam jodai na jix bhai' gu vaak guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu jiim guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ ba'k guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios bɨɨx guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ jix uam jodai guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn jix uam jodai.

Jano' ba' jix duu gio guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gook guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu u'u guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ maa'n tu jiim mambhɨɨx guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn juu'ñdham tɨkɨr ga'ra' jixchamaam guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn juu'ñdham tɨkɨr jixchamaam guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ; na ba' ka't mambhɨɨx guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ dɨr guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn bɨɨx ka'm guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ.
