Jano' ba' tu' tu jiim vupui bhaan tu' na ja'p jix jiim gu Dabii gu taat guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu i'ii'ñ guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ tu'x tu' jix duu guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm ñi'ook kavɨk guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ.

Jano' ba' gu Yo guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam atooxkor oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' bhaan gu Israeel na ba' bɨɨx tas na ja'p tu ñi'ook gu Dabii gu taat bham; gio ba' cham guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ tu' gu chio'ñ atooxkor gu Israeel.

Gu' gu' tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu ma'nkam cham guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu ñi'ook ñi'ook kavɨk tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam vupui bhaan guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat ua'tulhi'ñ guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios.

Jano' ba' tu' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu Israeel bhaan gu vupui gu oidha' dhagia'; gio ba' dhi' gu vaak guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu tɨɨgɨ' tu' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ vupui bhaan tu' gu Israeel ka't guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat bɨx gu ja'tkam.

Jano' ba' dhi' gu vaak ka't guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn no'x guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu Jawatan Dios dhi' gu oidha' dhi' gu vaak.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ; na gu' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix buusñi tattat gu oidha' gu Ejipto guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu novɨ gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ o'lhia guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim tu' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu Jawatan Dios bhaan bɨx guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam cham bhai'.
Jano' ba' ka't guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu Salomoon ka't guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gook gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios gu vaak vaak ja'tkam.

Jano' ba' na ba' gu iram gu gɨ'kora' gu Tiro ka't guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu Salomoon gu u'u gɨ' u'u kavɨk ka't guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam jix uam jodai guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu gɨ'kora' gu Salomoon jix maa gu iram guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ jɨ'dɨlh gu oidha' gu Galilea.
Jano' ba' jix buus gu iram gu Tiro na ba' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn jɨ'dɨlh gu Salomoon ka't jix maa cham guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim jɨ'dɨlh dhi' jix maa xibhɨk jix dhaas guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu tɨɨgɨ' gu oidha' gu Kabul bɨɨx ka'm guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ.
Jano' ba' ka't gu iram guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu gɨ'kora' chamaam guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ cha'tmam jix uam jodai.

Jano' ba' dhi' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam namki'ñdha' gu gɨ'kora' gu Salomoon guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios na ba' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios gu vaak gu Millo vaak jodai gu Jerusalem gu asor gu Megiddo gu Geser.

Jano' ba' gu Faraoon gu gɨ'kora' gu Ejipto ka't tu jiim guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu Geser guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim ka't jix koi gu Kananeos oi'ñka' kiicham guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ mar u'vɨ gu u'vɨ gu Salomoon.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu Salomoon gu Geser guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu Bet-oron.
Jano' ba' gu Baalat gu Tadmor gu oidha' oidha' jix gaki.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ jɨ'dɨlh pai' gu Salomoon ga'ra' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam jɨ'dɨlh guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam jɨ'dɨlh gu ja'tkam kavaayo bɨx gu Salomoon guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu Jerusalem gu Liibano bɨx gu oidha' aapi'.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu Amorreos gu eteos gu Pereseos gu ebeos gu Jebuseos cham jix bɨɨx duu gu ma'nkam gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' jix duu gu ma'nkam guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu oidha' mi' dhɨr gu ma'nkam gu Israeel cham guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu ñi'ook gu Salomoon guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ bɨɨx namki'ñdha' bɨɨx ka'm guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ.

Gu' gu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu Salomoon guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu chichio'ñ bhɨɨ'ñdham guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ chiñia' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu ja'tkam kavaayo.

Jano' ba' gu Salomoon ka't guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn bhaan buimɨi guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ mambhɨɨx mi'p bhaan gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam mii' dhɨr tu duukam.
Jano' ba' jix tɨ'ɨ mar u'vɨ gu Faraoon kiicham gu Dabii gu vaak gu Salomoon ka't guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ; gio ba' jano' ba' pai'x gu Millo.

Jano' ba' jix duu guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu Salomoon vaik mui'kim oidha' tas maa'nkar tai bhaan guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios bhaan ka't vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios mi' dhɨr gu vaak ka't gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix duu gio gu gɨ'kora' gu Salomoon guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Esioon-geber ju'ñdharan gu Elat guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu gɨ' suudai' gu Bermejo gu oidha' gu Edom.
Jano' ba' bhañ gu iram tu duukam tu jiim guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu gɨ' suudai' bɨɨx tu duukam gu Salomoon.
Jano' ba' jix bɨɨx duu gu Opir guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam jix uam jodai guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ cha'tmam aichdhak gu gɨ'kora' gu Salomoon.
Jano' ba' gu Oyendo guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu Seba guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Salomoon gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jawatan Dios suudai' u'va tu jiim bɨɨx tu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' suudai' u'va gu Jerusalem bɨɨx guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam jix gɨ' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga bɨɨx jix ai gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ jix uam jodai jix gɨ' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu jodai a'bhar; gio ba' na ja'p suudai' u'va gu Salomoon guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ bɨx gu i'ii'ñ ga'ra'.
Jano' ba' gu Salomoon jix duu guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu ñi'ook; gio ba' matgɨm guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu gɨ'kora' cham guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu Seba jix ñi' bɨx matda' gu Salomoon gu vaak ka't guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam jugi meesa guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ tu duukam dhi' jajannulhi'ñ guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat maa'nkar tai bhaan maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ.
Ba' jix aa' gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' tu'r tu' gu oidha' tu'x matda'.

Ba' jix aa' gu' tu' cham guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ bɨɨx ka'm tɨbiap gu vupui guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ buupui tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ tɨjɨɨ'ñ ka't; gio ba' jix gɨ' matda' xoi'kam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu' ka't naak.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu chio'ñ dhi' ja'tkam tu duukam guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn vupui bhaan tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ matda'.

Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios ka't guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ tu' na ba' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ atooxkor gu Israeel; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios tu' dha' bɨɨx tas gu Israeel tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu gɨ'kora' na ba' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa jix duu bɨx bhai'.

Jano' ba' jix maa gu gɨ'kora' chamaam guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ cha'tmam jix uam jodai guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu jodai a'bhar; gio ba' cham pai' dhuuk suudai' u'va guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios jix gɨ' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ na ja'p guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu Seba jix maa gu gɨ'kora' gu Salomoon.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu iram ka't guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ jix uam jodai gu Opir guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gio gu Opir guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu u'u guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu jodai a'bhar.

Jano' ba' jix duu gu u'u guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn na ba' gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios na ba' gu vaak guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gio guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ na ba' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ; gio ba' cham pai' dhuuk suudai' u'va guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu u'u guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn tu' buupui bɨɨx ka'm guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ.

Jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Salomoon jix maa guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu Seba bɨx guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ bɨx guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu Salomoon jix maa na ja'p gu novɨ gu gɨ'kora' gu Salomoon; gio ba' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ ka't gu oidha' bɨɨx guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ jix uam jodai gu Salomoon ga'ra' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ oidha' tas ka't guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn cha'tmam jix uam jodai.
Jano' ba' cham jix duu guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ bɨx gu gɨ'kora' gu Arabia gu ñi'ook gu oidha'.

Jano' ba' jix duu gio gu gɨ'kora' gu Salomoon guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa jix uam jodai guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn jix uam jodai guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam vaik kutun kavɨk jix uam jodai guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ maa'n guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn vaik guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat jix uam jodai; gio ba' jix dhaas gu gɨ'kora' gu vaak guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu Liibano.
Jano' ba' jix duu gio gu gɨ'kora' atooxkor guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ jix bhaan dhaas jix uam jodai guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam ga'ra' atooxkor guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ ka't guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ; gio ba' baasɨ'n ga'ra' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ mia'n guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ ju'ñdharan mi'p guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gook guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa.

Jano' ba' mi'p gio guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm bhaan guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam baasɨ'n; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' ka't guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam atooxkor nɨidhim.

Jano' ba' bɨx guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam i'i gu gɨ'kora' gu Salomoon guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm jix uam jodai guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam bɨx guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu vaak guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu Liibano ka't jix uam jodai guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga; gio ba' cham ka't jix toja jodai; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu Salomoon cham ka't guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn.

Na gu' na gu' gu gɨ'kora' ga'ra' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam busaak gu gɨ' suudai' gu Tarsis bɨɨx guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu iram; gio ba' tu jiim vaik guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu Tarsis guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ jix uam jodai jix toja jodai guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu gɨ'kora' gu Salomoon bɨx gu gɨ'kora' gu oidha' namkɨm matda'.

Jano' ba' bɨx gu oidha' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu Salomoon na ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ matda' gu Jawatan Dios ka't guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu i'ii'ñ.

Jano' ba' bɨx guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ oidha' tas guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam jix uam jodai guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam jix toja jodai jajannulhi'ñ gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa.

Jano' ba' jum daa'ñ gu Salomoon guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu ja'tkam kavaayo; gio ba' ga'ra' mambhɨɨx gɨ' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm mambhɨɨx gɨ' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn jix dhaas jɨ'dɨlh guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam bɨɨx gu gɨ'kora' gu Jerusalem.
Jano' ba' jix dhaas gu gɨ'kora' gu Jerusalem jix toja jodai na ja'p gu jodai guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn na ja'p chiiw guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm vaak ja'tkam guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm bhiibgich gu Salomoon gu Ejipto; na gu' chu'p jix duu gu gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm bhiibgich.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn busaak gu Ejipto guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ jix toja jodai kavaayo guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm chamaam mambhɨɨx; gio ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu novɨ bɨx gu gɨ'kora' gu eteos gu Siria.
Gu' gu' gu gɨ'kora' gu Salomoon guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ mar u'vɨ gu Faraoon mumua'da' gu u'vɨ jix duu; gio ba' gu Moab gu Ammoon gu Idumea gu Sidoon gu eteas.

Jano' ba' chɨbɨɨp gu Jawatan Dios ka't tu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Israeel; gio ba' cham ba'k tu' jɨjɨkgɨm guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat; na gu' gu ñi'ook jix duu guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga bhaan gu Jawatan Dios; jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ jum daa'ñ gu Salomoon bɨɨx xoi'kam.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu u'vɨ guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa vaik guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn; gio ba' gu u'vɨ guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu i'ii'ñ.

Jano' ba' tu' gu Salomoon ka't guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu u'vɨ guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios gu i'ii'ñ bhaan gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ; gio ba' gu i'ii'ñ cham ka't guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ bɨɨx gu Jawatan Dios na ja'p gu i'ii'ñ gu taat gu Dabii.
Na gu' na gu' gu Salomoon chɨ'ɨɨk gu Astarot gu Jawatan Dios gu Sidonios gu Milkom guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu Ammonitas.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu Salomoon cham bhai' gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios cham ka't guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ bhaan gu Jawatan Dios na ja'p gu Dabii gu taat.

Jano' ba' jix duu jano' ba' gu Salomoon guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu Kêmos guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu Moab gu kavɨk guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu Jerusalem; gio ba' gu Molok guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon.
Jano' ba' jix duu na ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu u'vɨ guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios.
Na gu' bhaam gu Jawatan Dios bhaan gu Salomoon na gu' ka't gu i'ii'ñ guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel ka't guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gook mui'kim.

Jano' ba' ka't jix duu guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam dhi' cham guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ; gu' cham guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm jix aa'ñdhix gu Jawatan Dios.

Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Salomoon; na gu' tu' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat dhi' tu' cham guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat ñi'ook na jix bhaan ñi'ook kavɨk tu' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' tu' kapbhai' tu duukam.
Gu' cham guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn cham guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu tanoolh guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm xoi'kam gu Dabii gu taat; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu novɨ gu mar.

Gu' cham guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn cham guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios bɨx oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ bopxi'ñ gu mar guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm xoi'kam gu Dabii tu duukam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm xoi'kam gu Jerusalem tu' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu Salomoon gu Adad gu Idumeo gu ɨ'ɨr vaak ja'tkam ka't gu Edom.
Na pai' dhuuk na gu' na pai' dhuuk gu Dabii ka't gu Edom jix tɨ'ɨ gu Joab guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn koko'kam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ bɨx gu chio'ñ gu Edom.
Na gu' na gu' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn masaa'n guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu Joab bɨx gu Israeel bɨɨx ka'm ka't gu ñi'ook bɨx guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu Edom; gio ba'.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu Adad bɨɨx dhɨt gu chio'ñ gu Idumeos tu duukam gu taat ka't gu Ejipto; gio ba' ka't jano' ba' gu Adad guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam jix ali'.

Jano' ba' jix búup gu Madiaan tɨɨtɨs gu Paraan; gio ba' dhaagɨk baidhak gu chichio'ñ gu Paraan tɨɨtɨs gu Ejipto gu Faraoon gu gɨ'kora' gu Ejipto jix maa gu vaak nɨi'ñchudat guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ jix maa gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Adad jix gɨ' nɨidhidha' vupui bhaan gu Faraoon jix maa guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu u'vɨ gu ja'tkam tɨɨmo' gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu Tapnes.

Jano' ba' gu ja'tkam gu Tapnes guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu mar gu Genubat guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu Tapnes tu jiim gu vaak gu Faraoon; gio ba' ka't gu Genubat gu vaak gu Faraoon tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Faraoon.

Ba' jix aa' tɨiñ gu Adad gu Ejipto gu Dabii ka't guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn bɨɨx tattat ka't jix koi gu Joab guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu Adad gu Faraoon; gio ba' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat tu' gu oidha'.

Jano' ba' jix aa' gu Faraoon; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim tu' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu oidha' jix aa'; mi' dhɨr cham tu'; jano' ba' bɨɨx bɨx guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn tu'.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gio gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu Resoon gu mar gu Eliada ka't guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu Adad-eser gu gɨ'kora' gu Soba.

Jano' ba' jix duu ka't guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu ja'tkam bhaan dua'ñ guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ chu'p na pai' dhuuk gu Dabii guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu Soba; gio ba' mi' dhɨr jix bɨɨx duu gu Damasko guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ tu' jix duu gu gɨ'kora' gu Damasko.
Jano' ba' ka't guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu Israeel bɨx gu tanoolh gu Salomoon; na gu' ka't cham bhai' bɨɨx gu Adad na gu' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu Israeel jix gɨ'kora' bhaan gu Siria.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu Jeroboam gu mar gu Nabat gu Eprateo gu Sereda tu duukam gu Salomoon gu naan guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu Serba gu u'vɨ ja'tkam na jix xoi'kam guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu novɨ bhaan gu gɨ'kora'.

Jano' ba' kuiñcha guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu novɨ bhaan gu gɨ'kora' ka't dhi'; gio ba' gu Salomoon guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu Millo guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam kiicham gu Dabii gu taat.

Jano' ba' gu chio'ñ gu Jeroboam ka't jix kavɨk guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn; gio ba' ñɨi'ñ gu Salomoon biapma' ka't gu chio'ñ guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim bɨx guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu vaak gu Josee.

Jano' ba' ka't mii' dhɨr guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gamai' gu Jeroboam gu Jerusalem guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu bhóogɨt jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu Aiias gu Silonita; gio ba' ka't jix bhaan dhaas bɨɨx guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios; mi' dhɨr mi'p gook guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ yooxi'.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu Aiias guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios ga'ra' bhaan guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm bapaalh.

Ba' jix aa' gu Jeroboam; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam na ba' tu' mambhɨɨx bapaalh; na gu' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel; jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu novɨ gu Salomoon tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ mambhɨɨx bopxi'ñ.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ bopxi'ñ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm xoi'kam gu Dabii tu duukam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm xoi'kam gu Jerusalem kiicham tu' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ bopxi'ñ gu Israeel; gio ba'.

Na gu' na gu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ tɨtda:―Cha'pim guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu Astarot gu Jawatan Dios gu Sidonios gu Kêmos gu Jawatan Dios gu Moab gu Molok gu Jawatan Dios gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon; gio ba' cham guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu bhóogɨt na ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam jix duu vupui bhaan gu vupui ñi'ook kavɨk guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ na ja'p gu Dabii gu taat.

Gu' cham guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn cham guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ cham tu' oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu noobh guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa bɨx gu tanoolh gu oidha' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm xoi'kam gu Dabii tu duukam tu' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu ñi'ook ñi'ook kavɨk.
Gu' gu' tu' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu novɨ gu mar guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ tu' mambhɨɨx bopxi'ñ.

Jano' ba' gu mar guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ bopxi'ñ na ba' tu duukam gu Dabii guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam bɨx gu tanoolh vupui bhaan tu' gu Jerusalem kiicham tu' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn na ba' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu tɨɨgɨ'.
Jano' ba' tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ tu' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ tu'x guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu i'ii'ñ ka' gu gɨ'kora' bhaan gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' jix duu ka't tu' tu jiim naak guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ tu'x tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ tu jiim gu bhóogɨt tu' tu jiim vupui bhaan gu vupui guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm ñi'ook kavɨk gu ñi'ook na ja'p gu Dabii tu duukam tu' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam bɨndak tu' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu vaak gu ñi'ook na ja'p guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Dabii tu' kapbhai' gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' tu' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu kai' gu Dabii kuiñcha dhi' gu' cham na ba' bɨɨx tas.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu Salomoon kooda' gu Jeroboam gu' kɨkbo gu Jeroboam guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu Ejipto gu Sisak gu gɨ'kora' gu Ejipto juruuñ gu Ejipto bɨɨx ka'm koi'm gu Salomoon.
Jano' ba' jix duu guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu Salomoon guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ tu'x matda' cham ua'ñix u'uan guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu Salomoon.
Jano' ba' gu tanoolh gu Salomoon jix gɨ'kora' gu Jerusalem bhaan bɨx gu Israeel jix bɨɨx duu oo'm guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ.
Jano' ba' jix koox gu Salomoon bɨɨx tattat ka't guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ kiicham gu taat gu Dabii; gio ba' jix gɨ'kora' pai' gu Roboam gu mar.
Jano' ba' ka't gu Roboam gu Sikêm; na gu' bɨx gu Israeel ka't tɨbiap gu Sikêm na ba' tu jiim gu gɨ'kora'.
Na gu' ka't na ja'p jix kai gu Jeroboam gu mar gu Nabat ka't gu Ejipto na gu' ka't guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam vupui bhaan gu gɨ'kora' gu Salomoon guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu Ejipto.
Jano' ba' mɨjɨ guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga; gio ba' suudai' u'va gu Jeroboam bɨx guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu Israeel tu ñi'ook gu Roboam bham.

Jano' ba' gu taat guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios chulhiiñdha' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu' jano' tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ juantu'n gu taat guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios jix dhaas bhaan no'ch tu' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ vaik gu tanoolh guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ tu'; mi' dhɨr gu ja'tkam ka't.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Roboam jix bhɨɨ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ bɨɨx daraa guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat dhi' vupui bhaan gu Salomoon gu taat na pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga; gio ba' gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat tu ñi'ook dhi' gu ja'tkam.

Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook bham; gio ba' tu' tu jiim guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ tu duukam dhi' gu ja'tkam tu jiim tu ñi'ook guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu ñi'ook ñiokda' tu' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa na ba' bɨɨx tas.

Gu' gu' tɨtda:―Cha'pim guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ nu'aa' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat jix maa jix bhɨɨ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ bɨɨx biipibop guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat jix duu bɨɨx mi'p vupui bhaan.

Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat tu ñi'ook dhi' gu ja'tkam tu' bham; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu taat jix dhaas bhaan no'ch.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' biipibop guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat jix duu bɨɨx tu ñi'ook bham; gio ba' tu ñi'ook dhi' gu ja'tkam tu' dhi' gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu taat guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios chulhiiñdha' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn; gu' tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim; gio ba' tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr jix ali' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ tu jiim guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu taat.

Jano' ba' jano' gu taat guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu' tu' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn; gio ba' gu taat naaka'n bɨɨx guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu' tu' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam bɨɨx guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn.
Jano' ba' vaik gu tanoolh suudai' u'va gu Jeroboam bɨɨx bɨx gu ja'tkam gu Roboam; gio ba' bhaan gu gɨ'kora' ka't jix duu bham; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ tu' vaik gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' jix aa' gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat tɨtda:―Cha'pim guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ daraa guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat jix maa.

Ba' jix aa' jurtu'nka' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ biipibop bham; gio ba' gu taat guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu' tu' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn; mi' dhɨr gu taat naaka'n bɨɨx guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu' tu' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam bɨɨx guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn.

Jano' ba' cham jix kai gu gɨ'kora' gu ja'tkam; na gu' ka't guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu Jawatan Dios na ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios ka't tu ñi'ook guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Aiias gu Silonita gu Jeroboam gu mar gu Nabat.

Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk bɨx gu ja'tkam jix ñi' gu gɨ'kora' cham ka't naak jix aa' dhi' gu ñi'ook bham; gio ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim baasɨ'n tañia' no'ch bɨɨx gu Dabii cham tañia' gu maa'nkar gu mar gu Isaii; mi' dhɨr gu Israeel dhi' gu Probee jano' gu vaak gu Dabii jano' ba' gu Israeel ka't dhi'.
Gu' gu' jix gɨ'kora' gu Roboam bhaan gu ma'nkam gu Israeel guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam jɨ'dɨlh gu Judaa.

Jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Roboam bhañ gu Adoram ka't bhaan bopxi'ñ; gu' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios bɨx gu Israeel jix koi; mi' dhɨr jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Roboam guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu Jerusalem.
Jano' ba' jix ai'chdhix gu Israeel gu vaak gu Dabii bɨɨx ka'm guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ.

Jano' ba' ka't tɨiñ bɨx gu Israeel gu Jeroboam ka't guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios mɨjɨ guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ tu' jix duu gu gɨ'kora' bhaan bɨx gu Israeel cham guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn bopxi'ñ guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu vaak gu Dabii guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ bopxi'ñ gu Judaa.

Jano' ba' na ja'p gu Roboam suudai' u'va gu Jerusalem jum daa'ñ bɨx gu vaak gu Judaa bopxi'ñ gu Benjamiin chamaam guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam mambhɨɨx gɨ' gu chichio'ñ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn bhɨɨ'ñdham na ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu vaak gu Israeel guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu Roboam gu mar gu Salomoon.
Gu' gu' ka't gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Semeiias gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios bham.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu Roboam gu mar gu Salomoon gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa bɨx gu vaak gu Judaa gu Benjamiin guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu ja'tkam bham.

Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' cham guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ bhaan gu ja'tkam gu ma'nkam gu Israeel; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn maa'n gu vaak; na gu' dhi' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios suulh jix bɨɨx duu jurtu'nka' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' jix duu guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu Jeroboam gu Sikêm gu kavɨk gu Epraim guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ; gio ba' gamai' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu Penuel.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jeroboam gu i'ii'ñ; gio ba' jano' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu vaak gu Dabii.

Jano' ba' tu' dhi' gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios gu Jerusalem; na gu' gu i'ii'ñ dhi' gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu Jawatan gu Roboam gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa yaa' tu' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu Roboam gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa.

Ba' jix aa' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ jix duu gu gɨ'kora' gook ali' vaakax jix uam jodai gu ja'tkam; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ tu jiim gu Jerusalem; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook gu Israeel tu' jix duu guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu oidha' gu Ejipto.
Jano' ba' jix dhaas maa'n gu Bet-el jix dhaas gu Dan.
Jano' ba' dhi' ka't bua' uañi'ñ; na gu' gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam vupui bhaan maa'n bɨɨx ka'm gu Dan.
Jano' ba' jix duu gio gu vaak guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios tu' jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu ja'tkam cham guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu ma'nkam gu Lebii.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu Jeroboam guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ jurtu'nka' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu Judaa; gio ba' maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan; mi' dhɨr jix duu gu Bet-el maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan ali' vaakax ka't guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam; jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gio gu Bet-el jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios ka't guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios.

Jano' ba' maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan ka't guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu Bet-el guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ ka't guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu i'ii'ñ; gio ba' tu' jix duu guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel jix tɨ'ɨ jodai maa'nkar Jawatan na ba' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios.

Jano' ba' gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios suudai' u'va gu Judaa gu Bet-el; gio ba' kua' gu Jeroboam jodai maa'nkar Jawatan na ba' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios.

Ba' jix aa' tu ñi'ook bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' jodai maa'nkar Jawatan tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu vaak gu Dabii guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu mar tɨɨgim gu Josiiyas maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan bhaan tu' jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ bhaan tu' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios; jano' ba' bhaan tu' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam o'oo gu chichio'ñ.

Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh jix maa nɨi'ñchudat bham; gio ba' dhi' nɨi'ñchudat gu Jawatan Dios tu' tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm jodai maa'nkar Jawatan guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn maatai bhaan guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios.

Ba' jix aa' na ja'p gu gɨ'kora' gu Jeroboam jix kai gu ñi'ook gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios ka't duuñ bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu Bet-el jix duu gu novɨ dɨr jodai maa'nkar Jawatan; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu' gu novɨ ka't guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ bhaan guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm cham guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios.

Jano' ba' jodai maa'nkar Jawatan guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ ja'aa maatai jodai maa'nkar Jawatan jurtu'nka' nɨi'ñchudat gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix maa guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' kai'ch:―Dho gu gɨ'kora' gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' tu' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu' gu novɨ ka't guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa; mi' dhɨr gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios gu novɨ gu gɨ'kora' tu jiim guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios na ja'p va'k.
Ba' jix aa' gu gɨ'kora' gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu vaak jugi tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm.

Ba' jix aa' gu' gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' tu' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu vaak cham guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ bɨndak tu' jugi gu takarui' tu' i'i gu suudai' dhi' pai'.

Na gu' na gu' jix duu guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bham; gio ba' cham guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu takarui' tu' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu suudai' tu' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu bhóogɨt tu jiim.
Jano' ba' ka't guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu bhóogɨt cham guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu bhóogɨt guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm pai' ka't tɨbiap gu Bet-el.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu Bet-el guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan suudai' u'va gu mar guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam bɨx gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios ka't guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh gu Bet-el; gio ba' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gio gu taat gu ñi'ook ka't tu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora'.

Ba' jix aa' gu taat; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu bhóogɨt ka't gu ma'nkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu bhóogɨt guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm pai' ka't guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios ka't tɨbiap gu Judaa.
Ba' jix aa' gu ma'nkam; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn buur; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim buur jix tɨ'ɨ.

Jano' ba' jiimchu' bhaan gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook ka't daakat bɨtaa'n guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn; gio ba' jix aa'; mi' dhɨr jix duu tu' gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu Judaa jix aa'; jano' ba' tu' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba'; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu vaak guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu takarui'.

Gu' gu' jix aa'; gio ba' cham guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ bɨndak tu' jix duu bɨndak; mi' dhɨr tu' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat jugi gu takarui' tu' i'ya' gu suudai' bɨndak dhi' pai'.

Na gu' na gu' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tu' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ tu ñi'ook; gio ba' cham guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu takarui' tu' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu suudai' tu' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu bhóogɨt tu jiim.

Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' tu' gio guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan na ja'p tu' nobii'ñ tu' tu ñi'ook guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bham; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ bɨndak gu vaak na ba' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu takarui' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu suudai'; gu' cham guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ bɨɨx jix jugi gu takarui' gu vaak jix i'i gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' ka't kua' meesa ka't gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan ka't guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ.

Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios ka't tɨbiap gu Judaa bham; gio ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios cham guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tu' ka't guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ.

Gu' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu takarui' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu suudai' pai' gu Jawatan Dios tu' ka't tu ñi'ook cham guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu takarui' tu' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu suudai' cham guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu chuukug tukga'n tattat.

Jano' ba' na ja'p ka't guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu takarui' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan ka't guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim buur.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios maavɨt gu bhóogɨt guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ; gio ba' gu chuukug ka't baas gu bhóogɨt buur ka't ju'ñdharan maavɨt gio ka't ju'ñdharan gu chuukug.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu chuukug ka't baas gu bhóogɨt maavɨt ka't ju'ñdharan gu chuukug; gio ba' tɨɨtɨs gui'p kiicham pai' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ.

Ba' jix aa' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim ka't guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu bhóogɨt; gio ba' gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios ka't guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; na ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu Jawatan Dios tu' dhagia' maavɨt tu' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam jix koi jurtu'nka' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios jix aa'.
Ba' jix aa' gu ma'nkam; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn buur; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim.

Jano' ba' ka't gu ñi'ook gu chuukug guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu bhóogɨt buur maavɨt mi'p ju'ñdharan gu chuukug; gio ba' maavɨt cham ka't guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu chuukug tu' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat buur.

Jano' ba' dhaagɨk jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu chuukug gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios jix dhaas bhaan buur guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ; gio ba' jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn suudai' u'va kiicham na ba' tu jiim jix duu.
Jano' ba' jix dhaas gu chuukug tukga'n; gio ba' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ bham; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook xibhɨk guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam.

Ba' jix aa' mi' dhɨr a'lhiok guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu ma'nkam bham; na pai' dhuuk tu' vaak jodai guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn tukga'n guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam o'oo ju'ñdharan guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ.

Ba' jix aa' na gu' cham guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga ɨlhdham jiiñak guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu Bet-el bhaan guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu vaak guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios jɨ'dɨlh gu Samaria.

Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr dhi' cham guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu Jeroboam cham bhai' gu bhóogɨt; gio ba' va'k guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn ka't jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios.
Jano' ba' dhi' ka't kuiñcha uañi'ñ gu vaak gu Jeroboam; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm ka't guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam bhaan gu vupui gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu Abiiyas gu mar gu Jeroboam guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn ka'ook.

Ba' jix aa' gu Jeroboam gu u'vɨ; na gu' bamii' jano' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn na gu' cham tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn jix duu gu u'vɨ gu Jeroboam tu' gu Silo; na gu Aiias jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan tu' ka't guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu gɨ'kora' bhaan dhi' gu ja'tkam.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu novɨ mambhɨɨx gu takarui' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm suudai' na jix bhai' tu'; na tu' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam tu' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim dhi' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ.

Jano' ba' jix duu gu u'vɨ gu Jeroboam; gio ba' jix búup ka't gu Silo suudai' u'va gu vaak gu Aiias; mi' dhɨr cham guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga tu' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu Aiias gu vupui guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios kuiñcha guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ.

Gu' gu' gu Jawatan Dios ka't tu ñi'ook gu Aiias; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu u'vɨ gu Jeroboam ɨlhdham guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu mar ka'ook; mi' dhɨr tu ñi'ook; na pai' dhuuk ka't na pai' dhuuk daraibu' ɨlhdham guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ.

Ba' jix aa' na ja'p gu Aiias jix kai guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam tɨɨt na pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm ki'ñgob; gio ba' ba'k gu u'vɨ gu Jeroboam; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim tu' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa cham guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn tu' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ tu' bɨɨx guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ.

Jano' ba' tu' gu Jeroboam; gio ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel; na gu' tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ja'tkam tu' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gɨ'kora' ja'tkam bhaan gu ja'tkam gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu vaak gu Dabii tu' kapbhai' tu'; gio ba' tu' cham guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ na ja'p gu Dabii tu duukam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu ñi'ook jix jiim guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam tu' bɨɨx bɨx gu i'ii'ñ guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam jix duu vupui bhaan gu vupui.

Jano' ba' va'k guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ cham bhai' bhaan bɨx guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ va'k tu'; na guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ tu' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn na ba' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios tu' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios bhaan guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ.

Na ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam cham bhai' bhaan gu vaak gu Jeroboam tu' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu Jeroboam bɨx guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat na ja'p guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu Israeel; gio ba' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu vaak gu Jeroboam na ja'p guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam bɨɨx ka'm ka't gu ñi'ook.
Na vaak jodai gu Jeroboam kiicham jugi guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ; gio ba' vaak jodai yooxi' jugi guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu u'uvhig gu tɨkɨr; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios tu' tu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' tu' bamii' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu vaak; na baakɨk tɨɨt kiicham guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ.

Jano' ba' bɨx gu Israeel guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn; na gu' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu Jeroboam guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn; na gu' tu' gaagam guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn jix bhai' gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel gu vaak gu Jeroboam.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu gɨ'kora' bhaan gu Israeel tu jiim gu vaak gu Jeroboam dhi' gu tanoolh; gio ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim tu' jano'.

Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu Israeel guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu suudai'; na gu' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu Israeel dhi' jix bhai' gu oidha' ka't jix maa tattat guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ baasɨ'n gɨ' suudai' jiim na gu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' kapbhai' gu Israeel guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm uañi'ñ gu Jeroboam guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu u'vɨ gu Jeroboam jix búup ka't suudai' u'va gu Tirsa; gio ba' baakɨk guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu vaak guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ jix koi.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ bɨx gu Israeel jurtu'nka' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios ka't tu ñi'ook guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu novɨ tu duukam gu Aiias jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan.
Jano' ba' jix duu guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu Jeroboam guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu ñi'ook jix gɨ'kora' bɨx ua'nak u'uan guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios jix gɨ'kora' gu Jeroboam jix bɨɨx duu guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ; gio ba' dhaibu guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn bɨɨx tattat jix gɨ'kora' pai' gu Nadab gu mar.

Jano' ba' gu Roboam gu mar gu Salomoon jix gɨ'kora' gu Judaa; na pai' dhuuk oo'm guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ ka't gu Roboam na pai' dhuuk kua'da' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ jix gɨ'kora' gu Jerusalem kiicham gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ bopxi'ñ gu Israeel na ba' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu tɨɨgɨ'; mi' dhɨr gu tɨɨgɨ' gu naan ka't gu Naama gu Ammonita.

Jano' ba' jix duu gu Judaa cham bhai' gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ bɨx tattat guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam uañi'ñ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn.

Na gu' na gu' gio guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios dhi' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam bɨx guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ bɨtaa'n bɨx gu u'u guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ.

Jano' ba' ka't gio guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu oidha' tu' jix duu jurtu'nka' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ chɨbɨɨp gu Jawatan Dios ka't baas vupui bhaan gu ma'nkam gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' jixchamaam oidha' tas gu gɨ'kora' gu Roboam jix tɨ'ɨ gu Sisak gu gɨ'kora' gu Ejipto bhaan gu Jerusalem.

Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu vaak vaak ja'tkam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ bɨx; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gio bɨx kutun kavɨk jix uam jodai gu Salomoon ka't guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam.

Jano' ba' jix duu pai' gu gɨ'kora' gu Roboam kutun kavɨk guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam jix maa gu noobh guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios ki'ñgob gu vaak vaak ja'tkam.

Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ; gio ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat.
Jano' ba' jix duu guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu Roboam guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ tu'x cham ua'ñix guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa.
Jano' ba' ka't bhɨɨ'ñdham tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Roboam gu Jeroboam bɨx gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' jix koox gu Roboam bɨɨx tattat ka't guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ bɨɨx tattat kiicham gu Dabii; gio ba' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu naan ka't gu Naama gu Ammonita; mi' dhɨr jix gɨ'kora' pai' gu Abiam gu mar.
Jano' ba' oidha' tas guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu gɨ'kora' gu Jeroboam gu mar gu Nabat gu Abiam kua'da' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa bhaan gu Judaa.
Jano' ba' jix gɨ'kora' vaik guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu Jerusalem; gio ba' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu naan ka't gu Maakâ mar u'vɨ gu Abisalom.

Jano' ba' jix jiim bɨx uañi'ñ gu taat ka't guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam va'k; gio ba' cham ka't gu i'ii'ñ guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ bɨɨx gu Jawatan Dios na ja'p gu i'ii'ñ gu Dabii gu taat.

Gu' gu' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm xoi'kam gu Dabii jix maa gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu Jerusalem guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu mar mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu Jerusalem.

Na gu' na gu' gu Dabii ka't guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam jix duu vupui bhaan gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios matgɨm guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim ka't guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ bɨx gu tanoolh gu oidha' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu Uriia gu eteo.
Jano' ba' ka't bhɨɨ'ñdham tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Roboam gu Jeroboam bɨx gu tanoolh gu oidha'.

Jano' ba' jix duu guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu Abiam guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ tu'x cham ua'ñix u'uan guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa ka't bhɨɨ'ñdham tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Abiam gu Jeroboam.
Jano' ba' jix koox gu Abiam bɨɨx tattat guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios kiicham gu Dabii; gio ba' jix gɨ'kora' gu Asa gu mar pai'.
