Jano' ba' kua'da' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu Akâb gu mar gu Omri bhaan gu Israeel oidha' tas guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu Asa gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa.

Jano' ba' jix gɨ'kora' gu Akâb gu mar gu Omri bhaan gu Israeel gu Samaria guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ; gio ba' gu Akâb gu mar gu Omri jix duu cham bhai' gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios bhaan bɨx jix bɨɨx duu va'k.

Na gu' na gu' ka't guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ uañi'ñ gu Jeroboam gu mar gu Nabat jix bhɨɨ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu u'vɨ gu Jesabel mar u'vɨ gu Etbaal gu gɨ'kora' gu Sidonios ka't guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu Baal guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam.
Jano' ba' jix duu jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu Baal vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan gu Baal pai'x gu Samaria.

Jano' ba' jix duu gio gu Akâb guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu Akâb guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ bɨx gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel va'k guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ.

Jano' ba' jix duu guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu iel gu Bet-el guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu Jerikoo; gio ba' gu Abiram maa'nkam mar guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu Segub gu mar kuugalhdha' jix dhaas kiki'ñgob; mi' dhɨr jurtu'nka' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios ka't tu ñi'ook guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Josuee gu mar gu Nun.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Eliiyas gu Tisbita ka't guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Galaad gu Akâb; gio ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel vupui bhaan dhi' cham guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios dhuuk tu' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ dhi' ja'tkam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' ka't gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bham.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ tas buusñi guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu Kerit vupui bhaan gu Jordaan.
Jano' ba' i'i guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn; gio ba' tu' jix duu guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios tu' jix maa jugi.
Jano' ba' jix duu ka't tu' jurtu'nka' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' ka't guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios ju'ñdharan guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu Kerit va'k gu Jordaan.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu takarui' gu chuukug guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu xibh gu takarui' gu chuukug gu xumai; gio ba' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn dhɨt gu tanoolh guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn; na gu' cham ka't guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios bhaan gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' ka't gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bham.

Jano' ba' bamii' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu Sarepta gu Sidoon guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu' jix duu gu u'vɨ ja'tkam na jix xoi'kam tu' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix búup ka't gu Sarepta; gio ba' na ja'p guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam ki'ñgob kiicham guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu u'vɨ ja'tkam na jix xoi'kam ka't guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim; mi' dhɨr jup tɨɨt jix aa'; jano' ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu suudai' vaaso na ba' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga.

Ba' jix aa' jiimchu' na ba' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga; gio ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gio gu chin gu takarui' gu novɨ.

Jano' ba' jix aa'; gio ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ cham no'ñ gu takarui' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim; na guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ no'ñ guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn bɨ'ñdhatu' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm; jano' ba' jano' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gook guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim na ba' ba'k tu jiim na ba' tu' na ba' gu mar guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios vaak jodai.

Ba' jix aa' gu Eliiyas; gio ba' cham cham tu'x jai'ch choo'n; mi' dhɨr tu' gu vupui na ja'p tu ñi'ook; gu' cham guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam tu' maa'n guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam bɨtaa'n maatai guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn; gio ba' mi' dhɨr jix duu na ba' tu' na ba' gu mar.

Na gu' na gu' gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel tu' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ cham guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam tu' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm bɨ'ñdhatu' bɨɨx ka'm mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh gu Jawatan Dios maa'n dhuuk bhaan gu vupui gu oidha'.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' ka't tu' jix duu na ja'p gu Eliiyas; gio ba' jix jugi gu vaak mui'x gu tanoolh.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ cham guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm bɨ'ñdhatu' jurtu'nka' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios ka't tu ñi'ook guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Eliiyas.

Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr dhi' tu'x ka't guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn ka'ook gu mar guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu vaak ko'kdai' ka't guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa cham guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ.

Ba' jix aa' gu Eliiyas; gio ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim no'ñ tu' bɨndak gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios tɨbiap tu' na ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ chɨ'ñchoka' tu' na cham jir bhai' na ba' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ koi gu mar.

Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu mar; mi' dhɨr jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam pai' ka't jix dhaas bhaan guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa.

Ba' jix aa' jiiñkɨk gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ ja'tkam na jix xoi'kam gu vaak tu' dhi' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu mar.

Ba' jix aa' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios bhaan guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam vaik mui'kim tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu i'ii'ñ dhi' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam ba'k.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios jix kai gu ñi'ook gu Eliiyas gu i'ii'ñ guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ ba'k guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim.

Ba' jix aa' dhaagɨk gu Eliiyas guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu vaak jix maa gu naan gu Eliiyas; gio ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu mar guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu u'vɨ gu Eliiyas; gio ba' jano' kakasnira' tu' jix duu gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tu'r gu chin.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn mui'x gu tanoolh ka't gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Eliiyas vaik oidha' tas bham; gio ba' tu' ba'm gu Akâb tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ dhuuk bhaan gu vupui gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' ka't gu Eliiyas tu jiim gu Akâb; gio ba' ka't guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam jix gɨ' bhiogi' gu Samaria.
Jano' ba' gu Akâb jup tɨɨt gu Abdiias guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu Abdiias ka't jix gɨ' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu Jawatan Dios.

Na pai' dhuuk na gu' na pai' dhuuk gu Jesabel guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios gu Abdiias jix bhɨɨ guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm mambhɨɨx guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu takarui' gu suudai'.

Ba' jix aa' gu Akâb gu Abdiias; gio ba' tu' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ suudai' buusñi gu suudai' bɨx guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm; na guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat bakia' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga bɨɨx guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu oidha' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa na ba' cham ga'n cham gu vaakax.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios tɨjɨɨ'ñ guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios na ba' tu jiim; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm ka't guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu bhóogɨt gu Abdiias ka't guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm.

Jano' ba' jiimchu' gu Abdiias guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu bhóogɨt guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios bɨɨx gu Eliiyas; gio ba' na ja'p guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn o'lhia'n bhaan gu vupui jix aa'; mi' dhɨr cham jix duu tu' gu Jawatan gu Eliiyas.
Jano' ba' jix aa'; gio ba' tu' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim; mi' dhɨr tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ; jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Eliiyas.
Ba' jix aa' gu'; gio ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim uañi'ñ na ba' tu' kapbhai' tu duukam gu novɨ gu Akâb na ba' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu Jawatan Dios cham tu' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu ja'tkam tu' oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' pai' gu Jawatan cham ka't guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ; gio ba' kai'ch:―Dho cham tu' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu ja'tkam tu' cham tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gaagam.
Jano' ba' jano' tu' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ; mi' dhɨr gu Eliiyas.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios tu' ka't guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn tu' gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ pai' tu' cham guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim; gio ba' bai'ñpu' tu' jix maa guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu Akâb cham gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ; mi' dhɨr tu duukam guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu Jawatan Dios dɨr guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios.

Na pai' dhuuk cham tu' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat na pai' dhuuk gu Jesabel guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios; na guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu chio'ñ jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios mambhɨɨx guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu takarui' gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' jano' tu ñi'ook tu'; gio ba' tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ; mi' dhɨr gu Eliiyas; na ba' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ.
Ba' jix aa' gu Eliiyas; gio ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ vupui bhaan dhi' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Abdiias ka't jix ai bɨɨx gu Akâb jix maa aa'ñdham; gio ba' gu Akâb suudai' u'va jix ai bɨɨx gu Eliiyas.
Ba' jix aa' na ja'p gu Akâb jix ñi' gu Eliiyas gu Akâb; gio ba' jix duu tu' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' jix aa'; gio ba' tu' cham guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu Israeel guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat tu' gu vaak gu taat guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu Baales.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam jano' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam bɨx gu Israeel gu kavɨk gu Karmelo guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ mambhɨɨx jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu Baal guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam kua'da' meesa gu Jesabel.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Akâb bhañ bɨx gu ma'nkam gu Israeel jum daa'ñ jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu kavɨk gu Karmelo.

Ba' jix aa' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu Eliiyas bɨx gu ja'tkam; gio ba' bɨɨx ka'm duuk guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat tɨjɨɨ'ñ gook guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ tu' gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ; mi' dhɨr tu' gu Baal guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam; jano' ba' gu ja'tkam cham jix aa' gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' gu Eliiyas guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu ja'tkam; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ tu' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios; gu' jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu Baal cham tu'x jai'ch guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ mambhɨɨx gu chichio'ñ.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gook gu vaakax guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn maa'n guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam bapaalh guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ bhaan gu u'u gu' cham guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu tai bɨtaa'n; gio ba' tu' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu vaakax guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios bhaan gu u'u guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu tai guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios bɨtaa'n.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jawatan Dios tu' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios tu ñi'ook guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu tai guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ ka't gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr bɨx gu ja'tkam jix aa' bham; jano' ba' xoi'kam tu ñi'ook.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Eliiyas jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu Baal; gio ba' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu vaakax guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn maa'n guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ; mi' dhɨr tu' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jawatan Dios gu' cham guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu tai bɨtaa'n.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu vaakax ka't jix maa guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ tu' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Baal dɨr gu xibh bɨɨx ka'm tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu tanoolh bham; gio ba' gu Baal guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu' cham ka't gu ñi'ook tu' tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr tɨjɨɨ'ñ guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam mia'n jodai maa'nkar Jawatan guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam.

Jano' ba' ka't tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu tanoolh gu Eliiyas guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ bham; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ juraa'n guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam tu' gu bhóogɨt; jano' ba' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios.

Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook jiiñak guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios bɨɨx guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam bɨɨx guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ jurtu'nka' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam bɨɨx ka'm guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu ɨ'ɨr bhaan.

Jano' ba' na ja'p guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu tanoolh guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ bɨɨx ka'm guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu maa'nkar guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm cham ka't gu ñi'ook tu' tu ñi'ook tu' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga.

Ba' jix aa' gu Eliiyas jano' ba' bɨx gu ja'tkam; gio ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam tu'; mi' dhɨr bɨx gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam; jano' ba' tu jiim jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios ka't guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga.

Jano' ba' dhaagɨk gu Eliiyas guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu jodai jurtu'nka' jɨɨ'ñdhidha' bopxi'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Jakob ka't guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bham gu Israeel ka't gu tɨɨgɨ'.

Jano' ba' jix duu bɨɨx gu jodai jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' mi' dhɨr jix duu guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat xikoolh jodai maa'nkar Jawatan guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gook jix daa gu kai'.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu u'u guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu vaakax bapaalh jix dhaas bhaan gu u'u.

Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' jix bhuup maakobh tu jiim gu suudai' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam bhaan maa'nkar tai bhaan bhaan gu u'u; mi' dhɨr jix aa'; jano' ba' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn tu jiim; gio ba' tu jiim jix duu; mi' dhɨr jix aa' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn; jano' ba' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ tu jiim; gio ba' tu' jix duu guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ tu jiim.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ xikoolh jodai maa'nkar Jawatan; gio ba' ka't gio guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu suudai' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat.

Ba' jix aa' na ja'p guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu tas jix duu maa'nkar tai bhaan guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu Eliiyas; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu Abraam gu Isaak gu Israeel ka't guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn tu' jix duu gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel tu' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim tu duukam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ dhi' tu'x.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ; na ba' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat dhi' gu ja'tkam tu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios jix duu gu Jawatan Dios tu' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu i'ii'ñ.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu tai gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam maa'nkar tai bhaan gu u'u gu jodai oo' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu suudai' mi'p guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn bɨx gu ja'tkam ia'rɨ bhaan guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gui'p; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios.

Ba' jix aa' gu Eliiyas; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu Baal cham guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat; jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu Eliiyas guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu Kisoon guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Eliiyas gu Akâb; gio ba' tu jiim guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn; na gu' jix gɨ' dhuuk guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ.
Jano' ba' gu Akâb jix tɨ'ɨ jugi i'i; gio ba' gu Eliiyas jix tɨ'ɨ guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu Karmelo; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu oidha' jix dhaas gu vupui tɨjɨɨ'ñ kɨkbok.

Ba' jix aa' jix duu; gio ba' tu jiim jano' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam bhaan gu gɨ' suudai'; mi' dhɨr jix tɨ'ɨ tu jiim jix aa'; jano' ba' cham cham tu'x jai'ch cham tu'; gio ba' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat kɨɨv mui'kim.

Ba' jix aa' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa tu jiim; gio ba' tu' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ toov na ja'p gu novɨ gu chio'ñ tu jiim gu gɨ' suudai'; mi' dhɨr jix aa'; jano' ba' tu' gu Akâb; na gu' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn na gu' dhuuk cham tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ.
Jano' ba' ka't kua' dhi' gu tɨkɨr guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam bɨɨx tɨbaa'ñ gu jɨvɨl; gio ba' ka't dhuuk; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu Akâb suudai' u'va gu Jesreel.

Jano' ba' gu novɨ gu Jawatan Dios ka't bhaan gu Eliiyas guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa suudai' u'va guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ vupui bhaan gu Akâb bɨɨx ka'm guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu Jesreel.

Jano' ba' gu Akab jix maa guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu Jesabel bɨx gu Eliiyas ka't guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam na ja'p ka't jix koi guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam bɨx jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' bhañ gu Jesabel gu Eliiyas mattuda' bham; gio ba' xoi'kam gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ tu' gu xibh dhi' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn tu' cham ka't guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga na ja'p maa'n.
Jano' ba' ñɨi'ñ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ jix búup ka't guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu oidha' suudai' u'va gu Beer-seba gu Judaa guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn jix duu.

Jano' ba' ka't guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm oidha' jix gaki gu tanoolh gu bhóogɨt suudai' u'va jix daa bɨtaa'n guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga; gio ba' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios koi jix aa'; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ tu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu i'ii'ñ; na cham guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim tu' tutkɨ tattat.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam bɨtaa'n guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm nobii'ñ guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam jix aa'; mi' dhɨr bamii' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' tu jiim guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam bhaan guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam vaaso gu suudai'; gio ba' jix jugi jix i'i guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ koox.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ nobii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gookim tu jiim guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam bham; gio ba' bamii' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam; na gu' gu bhóogɨt tu' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ.
Jano' ba' jix búup jix jugi jix i'i; gio ba' jix jiim bɨɨx gu kavɨk mii' dhɨr jugi oo'm gu tanoolh oo'm gu tukaa' bɨɨx ka'm gu kavɨk gu Jawatan Dios gu oreb.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim jumpa'n pai' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu tukaa'; gio ba' ka't gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios jix aa'; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu Eliiyas.

Jano' ba' jix aa'; gio ba' jix duu guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ; na gu' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ tɨtda:―Cha'pim ñi'ook na jix bhaan guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga jodai maa'nkar Jawatan guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ jix koi guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan; jano' ba' tu' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam na ba' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu oidha'.

Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam mai' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu kavɨk vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ jix gɨ' gu ñi'ook gu jɨvɨl guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu kakkavɨk guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios; gu' gu Jawatan Dios cham ka't gu jɨvɨl; gio ba' bhaan gu jɨvɨl gi'ndukɨ; gu' gu Jawatan Dios cham ka't gi'ndukɨ.
Jano' ba' bhaan gi'ndukɨ gu tai; gu' gu Jawatan Dios cham ka't gu tai; mi' dhɨr bhaan gu tai guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam.

Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk jix kai gu Eliiyas jix bhaan dhaas gu vupui bɨɨx guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios jix buus tu jiim ki'ñgob jumpa'n; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu ñi'ook bham; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu Eliiyas.

Jano' ba' jix aa'; gio ba' jix duu guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ; na gu' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ tɨtda:―Cha'pim ñi'ook na jix bhaan guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga jodai maa'nkar Jawatan guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ jix koi guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan; jano' ba' tu' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam na ba' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu oidha'.

Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' tu' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu bhóogɨt guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm oidha' jix gaki gu Damasko; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu asael guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu gɨ'kora' gu Siria.

Jano' ba' gu Jeuu gu mar gu Nimsi guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu gɨ'kora' bhaan gu Israeel; gio ba' gu Eliseeo gu mar gu Sapat gu Abelmeula guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios na ba' ka't jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan pai' tu'.

Jano' ba' ka't guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu asael gu Jeuu guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ; gio ba' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu Jeuu gu Eliseeo guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ.

Jano' ba' tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu Israeel kɨɨv mambhɨɨx gɨ'; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ kɨkbok cham guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu Baal guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ cham guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu ñi'ook gu Eliseeo gu mar gu Sapat tu jiim bɨɨx guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ vupui bhaan; gio ba' ka't maa'n guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim; mi' dhɨr bhɨi gu Eliiyas guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm vupui bhaan guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ bhaan guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu vaakax suudai' u'va guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu Eliiyas; gio ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu taat gu naan tu' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat; mi' dhɨr jix aa'; jano' ba' tu' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat; gio ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam tu'.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam jix bhɨɨ guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu vaakax guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ bɨɨx guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu vaakax guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu chuukug jix maa gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm; gio ba' mi' dhɨr jix búup ka't bhaan gu Eliiyas guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Ben-adad gu gɨ'kora' gu Siria jum daa'ñ bɨx ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham bɨɨx guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gook gu gɨ'kora' bɨɨx guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam; gio ba' jix tɨ'ɨ jix dhaas guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Samaria guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn.
Jano' ba' bhañ jix duu kiicham gu Akâb gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel bham.
Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Ben-adad; gio ba' jix toja jodai jix uam jodai guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu u'vɨ gu ma'nkam guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ.
Ba' jix aa' gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel; gio ba' na ja'p tu' tu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam tu' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ bɨx no'ñ.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ jix duu tu jiim gui'p; gio ba' jix aa' gu Ben-adad; mi' dhɨr tu' tu jiim guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam; jano' ba' jix toja jodai jix uam jodai gu u'vɨ gu ma'nkam maa'n.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu xibh dhi' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios tu' tu duukam kutun kavɨk gu vaak tu duukam; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam bɨɨx gu noobh guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ bɨx guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios jix duu.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel jup tɨɨt bɨx daraa gu oidha'; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat jano' gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam cham tu jiim guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat cham bhai'; na gu' tu' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ tu' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu u'vɨ gu ma'nkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm jix toja jodai guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm jix uam jodai; jano' ba' tu' cham guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa.
Jano' ba' bɨx daraa bɨx gu ja'tkam tu ñi'ook; gio ba' cham guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn tu' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa tu' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix aa' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu Ben-adad; gio ba' ja'xñi gu gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ bɨx guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ tu duukam gɨ'kora' ja'tkam; gu' dhi' cham guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam; gio ba' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ jix bɨɨx duu jix maa guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim.

Jano' ba' gu Ben-adad guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios tɨip guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam; gio ba' xoi'kam gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ oo' gu Samaria cham guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios bɨx gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn.
Ba' jix aa' gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel; gio ba' ja'xñi cham guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat na ja'p tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ.
Ba' jix aa' na ja'p jix kai dhi' gu ñi'ook kua' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios bɨɨx gu gɨ'kora' vaak zel tu duukam; gio ba' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam; mi' dhɨr jix dhaas bhaan kiicham.

Ba' jix aa' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu Akâb gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel; gio ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr buupui dhi' jix gɨ' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu' kapbhai' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu novɨ na ba' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn tu' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' jix aa' gu Akâb; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu novɨ chɨkka jix aa'; mi' dhɨr tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu novɨ guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ chiñia' oidha' gɨ'; gio ba' jix aa' gu Akâb; mi' dhɨr chɨkka kua'da' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ jix aa'; jano' ba' tu'.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ chiñia' oidha' gɨ' jix bɨɨx duu guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gook; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga bɨx gu ja'tkam bɨx gu ma'nkam gu Israeel jix bɨɨx duu kɨɨv mambhɨɨx gɨ'.

Jano' ba' moor tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu tanoolh; gio ba' ka't gu Ben-adad guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ vaak zel gu gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gook gu gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat tɨbiap u'ua'tɨdham.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ chiñia' oidha' gɨ' moor dharka'; gio ba' ka't gu Ben-adad guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ jix maa aa'ñdham bham; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu chichio'ñ gu Samaria.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba'; gio ba' tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm bhai'x i'ii'ñ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn ko'iix; mi' dhɨr tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim na ba' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn ko'iix.
Jano' ba' moor kiicham guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ chiñia' oidha' gɨ' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham.

Jano' ba' naaka'n maa'n guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn bhaan; gio ba' jiboi'ññor gu Siros guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu Israeel; mi' dhɨr gu gɨ'kora' gu Siria gu Ben-adad guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam kavaayo bɨɨx guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu ja'tkam kavaayo.
Jano' ba' jix buus gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel tu' naaka'n gu ja'tkam kavaayo guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu Siros bɨɨx jix gɨ' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ.

Ba' jix aa' jimɨɨk gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel; gio ba' tu' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam; na gu' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ oidha' tas gu gɨ'kora' gu Siria tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ bhaan tu'.

Jano' ba' tu duukam gu gɨ'kora' gu Siria gui'p; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu kakkavɨk guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam; gu' tu' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn bɨɨx guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn tu' cham guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa.
Jano' ba' gu vupui; gio ba' jix buusñi gu gɨ'kora' maa'n guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa pai'.

Jano' ba' tu' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham na ja'p ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam; gio ba' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat bɨɨx yooxi' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu' cham guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa; mi' dhɨr jix maa naak tu' jix duu.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ oidha' tas gu Ben-adad guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu Siros suudai' u'va gu Apek guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga bhaan gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel jix bɨɨx duu gio guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga dhaagɨk guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios jix bɨɨx duu guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios yooxi' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel vupui bhaan na ja'p gook guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa chiiw; mi' dhɨr gu Siros guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu oidha'.

Ba' jix aa' jimɨɨk jano' ba' gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel bham; gio ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' gu Siros guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu kakkavɨk cham gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ tu' kapbhai' bɨx dhi' jix gɨ' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu novɨ na ba' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat tu' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' kɨɨv gu tanoolh chooto'n guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ yooxi' vupui bhaan kɨɨv gu tanoolh jix maa guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu Siros gu tanoolh guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim mambhɨɨx gɨ' gu chichio'ñ tɨɨt.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam jiboi'ññor gu Apek kiicham; gio ba' vaak jodai guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn bhaan guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ kɨɨv mambhɨɨx gɨ' gu chichio'ñ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ; mi' dhɨr gio gu Ben-adad suudai' u'va guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ kiicham guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' tu duukam gui'p; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ naak gu gɨ'kora' gu vaak gu Israeel gu gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ jano' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ ɨɨbhidham guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel; jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios tu' u'ua'tɨda' gu oidha'.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ ɨɨbhidham tɨɨtɨs gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel gui'p; gio ba' tu duukam gu Ben-adad tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu i'ii'ñ; jano' ba' jix aa'; gio ba' tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn xibhɨk.

Jano' ba' dhi' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam mii' dhɨr ja'tkam gu chichio'ñ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios jootom guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam dhi' gu ñi'ook gu chin gui'p; gio ba' xibhɨk gu Ben-adad jix aa'; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn; jano' ba' gu Ben-adad jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Akâb jix duu guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios.

Ba' jix aa' gu Ben-adad; gio ba' jɨ'dɨlh gu taat jix bhɨɨ guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ tu' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn; mi' dhɨr gu vupui guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu Damasko na ba' tu' na ja'p gu taat jix duu gu Samaria; jano' ba' tu' jix aa' gu Akâb tu' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam jix duu bɨɨx dhi' ñi'ook na jix bhaan; gio ba' jix duu bɨɨx ñi'ook na jix bhaan guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn tu'.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu chio'ñ gu ma'nkam duiñchu' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ jano'; gu' gu chio'ñ cham guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ jix ko'k.

Ba' jix aa'; na gu' cham guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ tu' jix duu maavɨt; mi' dhɨr na ja'p jix ai'chdhix guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios maavɨt tu' naaka'n.
Ba' jix aa' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ bɨɨx gu chio'ñ; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ jano'; mi' dhɨr gu chio'ñ jix maa guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga tu' jix duu guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam.
Jano' ba' jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan ka't jix dhaas vupui bhaan gu gɨ'kora' gu bhóogɨt guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm bɨɨx tu jiim bhaan gu vupui.

Ba' jix aa' na ja'p gu gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ jix maa jiiñak gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' tu duukam jix buus tɨjɨɨ'ñ guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim maa'n guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu chio'ñ bham; jano' ba' gu Guarda dhi' gu chio'ñ tu' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu oidha' ka't guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios gɨ' maa'nkar jodai jix toja jodai.

Jano' ba' na ja'p tu duukam ka't guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios baasɨ'n guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ; gio ba' jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel jix aa'; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat ka't guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ; jano' ba' tu' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam.
Gu' gu' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios jootom tu jiim bhaan gu vupui gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn ka't jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan.

Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu novɨ gu chio'ñ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu oidha' ka't guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam.
Jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel ka't gu vaak jix duu guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu Samaria.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn dhi' ja'tkam guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat ka't gu Nabot gu Jesreel ga'ra' gu Jesreel oidha' u'va ju'ñdharan guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu Akâb gu gɨ'kora' gu Samaria.

Ba' jix aa' gu Akâb gu Nabot bham; na gu' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn oidha' u'va na ba' u'uu pai' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa na gu' mia'n ju'ñdharan gu vaak tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm oidha' u'va tutkɨ dhi'; mi' dhɨr tu' tutkɨ tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ tu' namkidha' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam tuumiñ.
Jano' ba' gu Nabot jix aa' gu Akâb; gio ba' cham jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix maa tu' gu maa'nkar tattat.

Jano' ba' suudai' u'va gu Akâb gu vaak jix duu guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu ñi'ook gu Nabot gu Jesreel ka't tu ñi'ook bham; gio ba' cham tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu maa'nkar tattat; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu vupui cham jix jugi gu takarui'.

Ba' jix aa' suudai' u'va gu u'vɨ gu Jesabel; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios jix duu gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ cham guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu takarui'.

Jano' ba' jix aa'; na gu' tu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu Nabot gu Jesreel guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios oidha' u'va guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tuumiñ tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam oidha' u'va guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm; mi' dhɨr jix aa'; jano' ba' tu' cham tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ pai' u'va.

Ba' jix aa' gu u'vɨ gu Jesabel; gio ba' jix duu tu' jano' gu gɨ'kora' bhaan gu Israeel gu Lebaantate guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu takarui' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam; mi' dhɨr tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ oidha' u'va gu Nabot gu Jesreel.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' ua'na guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Akâb guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga bɨɨx guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ bhañ daraa gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam kiicham bɨɨx gu Nabot.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga ua'na am:―Ja'pji; gio ba' gu Proklamad guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu Nabot guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu ja'tkam.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gook gu chichio'ñ guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn vupui bhaan guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ bhaan guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim; gio ba' tu' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu Jawatan Dios gu gɨ'kora'; mi' dhɨr jano' ba' jix buusñi guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa.
Jano' ba' kiicham daraa gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam kiicham jix duu na ja'p gu Jesabel jix aa'ñdhix jurtu'nka' ua'nak guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga ka't guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu Nabot guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu ja'tkam.

Jano' ba' tɨɨtɨs jano' ba' gook gu chichio'ñ guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn jix dhadhaa vupui bhaan; gio ba' mii' dhɨr ja'tkam gu chichio'ñ gu Belial guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam bhaan gu Nabot vupui bhaan gu ja'tkam bham; mi' dhɨr gu Nabot tu' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu Jawatan Dios gu gɨ'kora'; jano' ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn mai' kiicham guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios bɨɨx gu jodai jix koi.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr mɨjɨ guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu Jesabel; gio ba' gu Nabot tu' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm jix koi.

Ba' jix aa' na ja'p gu Jesabel jix kai gu Nabot ka't guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm jix koi gu Akâb; gio ba' bamii' bia'ka' oidha' u'va gu Nabot gu Jesreel cham tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tuumiñ; na gu' gu Nabot cham guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat jix koi.
Jano' ba' tɨiñ gu Akâb gu Nabot ka't jix koi jix búup na ba' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam oidha' u'va gu Nabot gu Jesreel na ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu maa'nkar.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' ka't gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Eliiyas gu Tisbita bham.

Jano' ba' bamii' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios bɨɨx gu Akâb gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel gu Samaria; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm oidha' u'va gu Nabot tu' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa na ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu maa'nkar.

Jano' ba' ñiokda' bham; gio ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr cham guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gio guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam ñiokda' bham; jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' pai' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu ɨ'ɨr gu Nabot guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gio gu ɨ'ɨr guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ.

Ba' jix aa' gu Akâb gu Eliiyas; gio ba' gaagam bhaamki'ñdha' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam jix aa'; na gu' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm na gu' tu' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios cham bhai' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam cham bhai' bhaan tu' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu Akâb bɨx guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' tu' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu vaak na ja'p gu vaak gu Jeroboam gu mar gu Nabat na ja'p gu vaak gu Baasa gu mar gu Aiia; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios bɨɨx guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ bɨɨx guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' gu Jesabel gio tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bham; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ jugi gu Jesabel guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios gu Jesreel.
Na gu Akâb ua'tulhi'ñ jix koi kiicham guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ jugi; gio ba' ua'tulhi'ñ jix koi yooxi' jugi guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu u'uvhig gu tɨkɨr.

Jano' ba' tu'r guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ ka't na ja'p gu Akâb guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam cham bhai' gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' gu Jesabel gu u'vɨ guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn.

Jano' ba' ka't jix gɨ' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam duiñxim jurtu'nka' bɨx jix duu gu Amorreos u'u kavɨk gu Jawatan Dios vupui bhaan gu ma'nkam gu Israeel; gio ba'.

Na pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam na pai' dhuuk gu Akâb jix kai dhi' gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ jajannulhi'ñ jix dhaas guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios bhaan gu chuukug guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn jix koox guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios jix jiim jix duu.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' ka't gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Eliiyas gu Tisbita bham.

Na gu' cham buupui na ja'p gu Akâb tu' jix duu vupui bhaan tu' na gu' tu' vupui bhaan tu' cham guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ cham bhai' gu tanoolh; gio ba' gu tanoolh gu mar guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ cham bhai' bhaan gu vaak.
Jano' ba' vaik guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ cham bhɨɨ'ñdham tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Siros tu' gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' ka't vaik oidha' tas gu Josapat gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa jix dhaav gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel.

Ba' jix aa' gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel tu duukam; gio ba' cham guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu Ramot gu Galaad no'ch guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam jix bhɨɨ gu novɨ gu gɨ'kora' gu Siria.

Ba' jix aa' gu Josapat; gio ba' tu jiim guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga bhaan gu Ramot gu Galaad gu Josapat jix aa' gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel; mi' dhɨr na ja'p tu'; jano' ba' na ja'p gu ja'tkam; gio ba' na ja'p guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm.
Ba' jix aa' gu Josapat gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel; gio ba' tu' soi'ñ guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel jum daa'ñ na ja'p guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu chichio'ñ; gio ba' jix duu bhɨɨ'ñdham bhaan gu Ramot gu Galaad guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gui'p; mi' dhɨr tu jiim; na gu' gu Jawatan kapbhai' gu novɨ gu gɨ'kora'.

Ba' jix aa' gu Josapat; gio ba' cham tu'x jai'ch guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam.

Jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel jix aa' gu Josapat; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ cham tu'x jai'ch gu chio'ñ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu Jawatan Dios gu Mikêas gu mar gu Imla; na gu' gu' tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ na gu' cham pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ xoi'kam guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam cham bhai'; jano' ba' gu Josapat jix aa'; gio ba' cham tu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora'.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel jup tɨɨt guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ; gio ba' jix duu jootom gu Mikêas gu mar gu Imla.

Jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel gu Josapat gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa mi'p guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ maa'n guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam jajannulhi'ñ guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam ɨrban ju'ñdharan ba'k ki'ñgob gu Samaria; gio ba' bɨx jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios vupui bhaan.

Ba' jix aa' gu Sedekîas gu mar gu Kânaana ka't guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam a'aa' jix kavɨk jodai; gio ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr bɨɨx suulhgia' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu Siros bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' bɨx jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios bham; gio ba' tu jiim gu Ramot gu Galaad ka' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn; na gu Jawatan Dios maa'n gu novɨ gu gɨ'kora'.

Ba' jix aa' mattuda' ka't guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu Mikêas bham; gio ba' gu Miren gu ñi'ook jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu chin guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu gɨ'kora' xoi'kam; mi' dhɨr ka't jano' gu ñi'ook jurtu'nka' gu ñi'ook oi'ñdha' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ xoi'kam.
Jano' ba' gu Mikêas jix aa'; gio ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu Jawatan Dios tu ñi'ook guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios.

Ba' jix aa' suudai' u'va gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' gu Mikêas guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga bhaan gu Ramot gu Galaad guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ jix aa'; mi' dhɨr tu jiim ka' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu Jawatan Dios kapbhai' gu novɨ gu gɨ'kora'.

Ba' jix aa' gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' bɨɨx ka'm guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ mui'kim guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios cham guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat tu'r gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jawatan Dios.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba'; gio ba' tu' bɨx gu Israeel guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu kakkavɨk na ja'p kakneer cham namki' bipia'dam; mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan Dios jix aa'; jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam cham namki' gu Jawatan; gio ba' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam maa'n gu vaak bhai'x i'ii'ñ.

Ba' jix aa' gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel gu Josapat; gio ba' cham tu' ka't tu' tu ñi'ook gu Ninguna guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn jix bhai' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam tu' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam cham bhai'.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba'; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr tu' gu Jawatan Dios daakat atooxkor bɨx ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu tɨkɨr ka't ju'ñdharan kɨɨ'n guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' chɨkka guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu Akâb na ba' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu Ramot gu Galaad maa'n chɨtda; mi' dhɨr chɨtda.
Ba' jix aa' jix buus gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ jix dhaas vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' tu' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam; mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan Dios jix aa'; jano' ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim.

Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu Yo guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu chin bɨx jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan; mi' dhɨr jix aa'; jano' ba' tu jiim guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga bɨɨx guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn.

Jano' ba' jano' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Jawatan Dios tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu chin bɨx dhi' ja'tkam jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ cham bhai' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam tu'.

Jano' ba' jimɨɨk jano' ba' gu Sedekîas gu mar gu Kânaana naaka'n gu Mikêas guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm bham; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm duukat ka't tu' gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios na ba' tu ñi'ook tu'.

Jano' ba' gu Mikêas jix aa'; na pai' dhuuk gu Miren tu' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh na pai' dhuuk tu' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu Mikêas guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu Amoon guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ kiicham gu Joas gu mar gu gɨ'kora'.

Jano' ba' daipu'; gio ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora'; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam kuupa' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam bɨɨx gu takarui' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ bɨɨx gu suudai' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios bɨɨx ka'm tu' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga bhai'x i'ii'ñ.

Ba' jix aa' gu Mikêas; gio ba' tu' jix duu guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ bhai'x i'ii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios cham tu' tu ñi'ook guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu'; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam jix aa'; jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu ja'tkam bɨx.
Jano' ba' jix tɨ'ɨ gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel bɨɨx gu Josapat gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa gu Ramot gu Galaad.

Ba' jix aa' gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel gu Josapat; gio ba' tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ ba'k guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ; mi' dhɨr tu' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios jajannulhi'ñ; jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm chɨbiapui guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ.

Jano' ba' ñɨi'ñ jano' ba' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam cham ka't gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa.

Jano' ba' gu chio'ñ jix duu u'u gat guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios naaka'n gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tɨjɨɨ'ñ guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu ñi'ook; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm jix aa' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios yooxi' dhi' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu tas jix buus guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm yooxi' bham; gio ba' maa'n kiicham gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' jix koi gu gɨ'kora' ka't guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu Samaria; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu gɨ'kora' gu Samaria.

Jano' ba' gu Josapat gu mar gu Asa kua'da' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa bhaan gu Judaa maakobh oidha' tas gu Akâb gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel.

Na pai' dhuuk ka't gu Josapat guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ jixchamaam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ na pai' dhuuk kua'da' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa jix gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu Jerusalem; gio ba' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu naan ka't gu Asuba mar u'vɨ gu Silai.
Jano' ba' jix jiim bɨx gu bhóogɨt gu Asa gu taat cham guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam jix duu gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' bɨɨx bɨx guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios cham jix bɨɨx duu guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam; na gu ja'tkam maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu Josapat bhai'x i'ii'ñ bɨɨx gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' cham ka't jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Edom; gio ba' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa ka't pai' gu gɨ'kora'.

Jano' ba' ka't gu Josapat guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Tarsis guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat tu' gu Opir guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm jix uam jodai; na gu' gu' cham jix bɨɨx duu na gu' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu Esion-geber.

Jano' ba' gu Okôsiias gu mar gu Akâb kua'da' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa bhaan gu Israeel gu Samaria oidha' tas guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu Josapat gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa; gio ba' jix gɨ'kora' gook guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ bhaan gu Israeel.
